articleTitle: UWB Indoor Positioning Algorithm Based on TDOA Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The traditional positioning system based on Global Positioning System (GPS) has provided a lot of convenience for people in the outdoor environment. With the continuous improvement of people's living standards in recent years, the indoor location is more and more popular in intelligent shopping malls and intelligent campus. The traditional GPS location accuracy is limited, so it cannot be used indoor. At present, indoor location technology mainly includes infrared, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi and wireless location which relates to indoor mobile network. Among them, wireless location technology is a research hotspot. Least Squares (LS) method, Chan algorithm and Taylor algorithm based on TDOA in UWB indoor positioning technology are analyzed and tested with dynamic and static data in indoor line-of-sight environment. Results show that the three positioning algorithms can achieve decimeter-level positioning accuracy, and the Taylor algorithm can achieve a 1-decimeter positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: BioBERT Based Named Entity Recognition in Electronic Medical Record
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The identification and mining of entities in Electronic Medical Record (EMR) plays an important role in medical diagnosis. This paper used the BioBERT model based on Google BERT model for automatic annotation of clinical problems, treatments and tests in EMR. This method firstly pre-trained BioBERT model on the corpus of medical related fields to convert the text into a numerical vector. Next, the BiLSTM-CRF model was used to train the processed vectors and finally complete the entity tagging. The I2B2 2010 challenge dataset was used in the experiment. The experimental results show that the method can obviously improve performance of named entity recognition (NER) for EMR. The F1 score of the experiment is 87.10%, which meet the needs of clinical system applications and can promote the study of clinical decision in the future.

articleTitle: CT Images Recognition of Pulmonary Tuberculosis Based on Improved Faster RCNN and U-Net
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Pulmonary tuberculosis has the characteristics of polymorphism, multi-site, multi-nodule and cavity, so it is difficult to be identified in lung CT images. At present, there are two main methods for tuberculosis recognition in CT images: manual recognition and computer-aided recognition. Manual recognition will expend much energy, and medical staff would miss diagnosis or even misdiagnosis under the high-intensity work pressure. Most of the computer-aided recognition methods use traditional methods, and the recognition effect is poor. In this paper, we focus on the recognition of pulmonary tuberculosis based on CT images, and improve the traditional CT analysis process, which has two steps of segmentation and classification. We construct an improved deep network model of combining U-Net and Faster-RCNN, which is optimized by Res block. The model can detect and identify the tuberculosis lesions in pre-processed CT images simultaneously. A large number of experimental results show that our model has better effects on tuberculosis recognition than other machine learning models.

articleTitle: Tomato Diseases Recognition Based on Faster RCNN
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Plant diseases are a major challenge for the agricultural sector. Accurate and rapid detection of diseases in plants can greatly reduce economic losses. In this paper, we present a method based on Faster RCNN to detect tomato diseases. We combine Faster RCNN with different deep convolutional neural networks, including vgg16, resnet50, and resnet101. We trained and tested the collected tomato diseased dataset, which contained six diseased images and healthy tomato fruit images. The experimental results show that our proposed system can effectively identify different types of tomato diseases.

articleTitle: Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis Model Based on Three-Dimensional Full Convolutional DenseNet
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Dementia has become one of the major diseases causing death and disability in the elderly. Alzheimer's disease is the primary cause of dementia, and its clinical diagnosis, especially early diagnosis, is very urgent. The research on the diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease based on deep convolutional neural network has made good progress. However, it is still difficult to meet the requirements of clinical application. In clinic, most of them are structural MRI images, with limited sample size and few scanning layers. But deep learning needs enough annotated data. Aiming at the practical needs of clinical diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease, this paper proposes a increment method of dataset by weighted combination of positive and negative samples and a learning method for small number of samples, and establishes a 3D full convolutional DenseNet classification model, which can not only obtain better image feature information, but also improve the generalization ability of the model.

articleTitle: Learning Behavior Analysis and Dropout Rate Prediction Based on MOOCs Data
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the continuous development of the MOOC, a large number of learners have joined the online classroom. Distance education has the advantage of being free from time and geographical restrictions. However, it still faces the dilemma of high dropout rate and the continuous loss of learners. By studying the MOOC log data, we model the various behaviors of students and hope to make more accurate predictions of dropout rates. The student's learning sequence information is essentially time-series data, and the time interval between events is often different, which leads to difficulties in prediction. Therefore, we propose a time-controlled Long Short-Term Memory neural network (E-LSTM) prediction model that incorporates time-control units, the unit has the ability to model early learning behaviors with different time intervals. Based on the original LSTM model, we design time-controlled gates to better capture long-and short-term information and simulate learning process information to improve forecast performance. The experimental results on the real MOOC dataset show that the accuracy of the proposed model is higher than that of multiple comparison models, which proves the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Virtual Reality Therapy and Machine Learning Techniques in Drug Addiction Treatment
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the continuous development of machine learning technology, machine learning methods have broad application prospects in medical data mining. This paper proposes a method of using virtual reality technology to assist drug addiction treatments with a sample size of 58 drug abusers in a drug rehabilitation center located in Zhejiang province, China. In the process of drug addicts watching VR videos in different scenes, physiological data of concentration and heart rate are collected. A hybrid machine learning technique that combines principal component analysis (PCA) and K-Means++ clustering algorithm is used to cluster drug addicts to find out the relationship between cardiac physiological characteristic data and treatment effect. The experimental results show that after VR treatment, the mean and standard deviation heart rate of the patients have decreased significantly, which provides a firm evidence that the patient's response to drug stimulation is severely reduced after VR treatments. The conclusion was drawn that the virtual reality is indeed effective in assisting detoxification.

articleTitle: Research on Government Information Sharing Model Using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Research Purpose: The distributed, traceable and security of blockchain technology are applicable to the construction of new government information resource models, which could eliminate the barn effect and trust in government information sharing, as well as promoting the transformation of government affairs from management to service, it is also of great significance to the sharing of government information and construction of service-oriented e-government. Propose Methods: By analyzing the current problems of government information sharing, combined with literature research, this paper proposes the theoretical framework and advantages of blockchain technology applied to government information management and sharing, expounds the blockchain-based solution, it also constructs a government information sharing model based on blockchain, and gives implementation strategies at the technical and management levels. Results and Conclusion: The government information sharing model based on the blockchain solution and the transparency of government information can be used as a research framework for information interaction analysis between the government and users. It can also promote the construction and development of information sharing for Chinese government, as well as providing unified information sharing solution at the departmental and regional levels for e-government.

Author Keywords: Blockchain, Government Information Sharing, E-government, Barn Effect

articleTitle: A Detection Method for Tomato Fruit Common Physiological Diseases Based on YOLOv2
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The detection of tomato fruit physiological diseases can increase tomato yields and facilitate tomato fruit quality control. In this paper, a convolutional neural network called YOLOv2 was applied on the detection of healthy tomato fruits and tomato fruits with common physiological diseases. YOLOv2 is a target detection algorithm based on regression model, which has fast detection speed and good accuracy. In order to improve the network detection performance, the following improvements were made: First, image datasets were extended by data augmentation methods to decrease the chance of overfitting, and the augmented datasets containing 1000 tomato fruit images were obtained. Second, a grayscale processing module and a foreground extraction module were constructed to investigate the importance of image data type. Third, k-means clustering algorithm was applied in order to reduce model training time as well as improve detection effects. The mAP (mean Average Precision) of YOLOv2 tomato fruit detection network was 97.24%. Experimental results showed that the proposed method was effective on the detection of healthy tomato fruits and tomato fruits with common physiological diseases.

articleTitle: Constructing Knowledge Graph from Big Data of Smart Grids
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The big data of grid is characterized by a large amount of data and complex structure. There are many kinds of grid equipment in the grid and smart grid, and their relationships are complicated. Therefore, it is necessary to analyze and visualize the grid equipment information and relationships reasonably to improve and develop the grid information system. The power equipment information in the data center is relatively complex and does not reflect the relationships between the equipment well. In order to manage and use grid equipment information better, we propose a grid equipment knowledge graph to solve the problem of "information island" of smart grid equipment. A knowledge graph has been constructed according to the grid equipment big data from the grid domain data center, which reflects the multifaceted information of the equipment as well as inter-equipment relationships.

articleTitle: Improved Mask R-CNN for Lung Nodule Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With more and more people suffer from lung cancer, computer-aided diagnosis plays a more and more important role in lung cancer diagnosis. CNN has achieved state-of-the-art performance in image processing, and Mask R-CNN outperforms most other methods on instance segmentation. However, the target is extraordinarily small, and the background is very large in images, which results in a large number of negative examples and most of them are easy negatives. They will contribute a large part of the loss value in smooth loss function. The class imbalance problem leads to inefficient training, which makes model degenerated. In this paper, we propose a method based on Mask R-CNN to segment lung nodules. Due to the non-uniformity of CT values, we use the Laplacian operator to do feature dimensionality reduction for filtering out part of the noise. In our model, the novel function Focal Loss is used to suppress well-classified examples. The model is tested on LIDC-IDRI dataset and the results showed that the average precision of lung nodules reaches 78%. Compared with the smooth loss function in Mask R-CNN it improves by 7%.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Histopathological Image Classification using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The paper employs deep learning to classify breast cancer histopathological image into benign and malignant categories. The Inception v1 convolutional neural network is mainly adopted. Spatial Pyramid Pooling and special global average pooling are added to the network to ensure that images can be imported in the original aspect ratio format. The experimental results show that the convolutional neural network performs well in breast cancer image classification, and the Global Average Pooling effect is slightly better than the Spatial Pyramid Pooling.

articleTitle: Research on Teaching Presence Evaluation Indexes of Online Course
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Online courses are short of face-to-face and direct communication compared with classroom teaching, and the in-depth communication between teachers and students can only occur in the environment of high level of teaching presence. Therefore, how to establish and evaluate the presence in online teaching is the research objective. For the evaluation of teaching presence of online teaching, two-level evaluation index system is set up in a hierarchical way in our research. The first-level evaluation indexes include design organization; facilitate discussion and direct guidance. The primary evaluation index is refined in the second level evaluation indexes. The SPOC course “computer composition principle” is evaluated according to the two-level evaluation indexes. By analyzing the result, it can be concluded that the teaching presence evaluation indexes can provide effective references for teachers to improve teaching methods and teaching design, and form closed-loop feedback.

articleTitle: The Study on Students' Participation in Personalized Learning Under the Background of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Artificial intelligence provides strong technical support for the personalized learning. However, students' participation is the key core of learning effect. From the perspective of understanding students, this paper analyzes the student-centered learning; discusses the reliability of the technology-driven personalized learning in promoting students autonomy and establishing the feedback and assessment; summarizes the key factors that affect students' participation, and draws the technology-driven personalized learning model. On this basis, focusing on motivation, understanding beliefs, and participating in learning communities, three-layer architecture of learning to do something is built. The study provides the theory, experience and methods that can be used for the integration of artificial intelligence into education and the promotion of personalized learning.

articleTitle: Research on Teaching Process Management and Quality Monitoring System for Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: As is well known that teaching process management and quality monitoring significantly affect the teaching quality of higher education. Therefore, in this paper, we aim to analyze the importance of teaching process management and teaching quality monitoring in advance, and then we design and develop an effective teaching management system for teaching practice. Particularly, the intelligent information processing and mining technology are exploited as the main methods in the proposed system. Furthermore, the proposed system can greatly adapt to specific requirements of teaching process in colleges and universities. By analyzing and mining the data produced by the proposed system, we can find out the teaching rules and the bottleneck that affects the further improvement of teaching quality. In the proposed system, the teaching process management is defined to contain three aspects: 1) managing teachers' teaching, 2) managing students' learning, and 3) visualizing the data in the whole teaching process. We have used the proposed teaching mode for one year, and the reflection of students for the proposed new teaching pattern as listed as follows: 1) it can significantly improve the teaching quality, 2) students' learning process can be effectively monitored, and 3) the proposed system can accurately find the problems in the teaching process. In summary, the conclusions are drawn that the proposed system is of great significance to improve both the teaching quality and the teaching management level.

articleTitle: Attention-Based Bidirectional Hierarchical LSTM Networks for Text Semantic Classification
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Recently, in the semantic classification task at the document level, the traditional semantic classification method still has challenges in coding the hierarchical relationship between word level and sentence level. Aiming at this problem, we construct a bidirectional hierarchical LSTM network model (HBLSTM-ATT) based on the attention mechanism, and calculate the correlation before and after the sentence. At the same time, this paper focuses on document-level classification, using hierarchical structures to build document-level vectors from word vectors. Experimental results on Yelp, IMDB, Yahoo Answer and Amazon review datasets show that the proposed method is efficient in text semantic classification tasks compared to previous machine learning methods, and the semantic classification methods for gated neural networks. The accuracy rate for classification and stability have robust superiority over competitors and achieve the state-of-the-art results.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Application of RFID Technology in Medical Waste Management
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: To explore the application of RFID technology in medical waste management, and to clarify the positive effect of RFID technology on medical waste disposal. Methods: through the literature research analysis of the current situation of medical waste disposal and understanding about the RFID technology, combined with descriptive study to clarify the advantages and disadvantages of RFID technology and the technology in the process of regulation of medical waste concrete application process. Results: combination of RFID technology and video monitoring technology and large data cloud storage platform is 99% + / - 0.5 in medical waste management to avoid the loss of medical waste or illegally recycling. Conclusion: RFID technology can play a real and effective role in medical waste treatment.

articleTitle: Exploration and Practice of the Experiment Teaching of Web Application Security Course
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In the experiment teaching of Web application security course, we introduce a teaching assistant system - DVWA, which is vulnerable to the most common types of web application. We design the experiment cases for each Web application vulnerability from two aspects of attack and defense based on DVWA, and apply the multi-round progressive attack-defense confrontation mode to organize the experiment teaching. Teaching practice shows that the method increases the interest of students' learning and improves their ability of Web attack-defense.

articleTitle: Study on MOOC Withdrawal Rate Based on Graph Community Detection Model
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: MOOC (massive open online courses), is a brand new learning mode characterized by diversified tools and resources, easy to use and widely accepted courses, and autonomy of participation. MOOC has provided a new method and path to promote the sharing of high-quality education resources. After six years of rapid development, China's MOOC construction has formed a good situation of common development. MOOC has a high enrollment rate and dropout rate, so it is of great significance to study whether students drop out of courses and how to carry out the courses. In this paper, we propose a binary Graph Community Detection algorithm, which uses the binary conditional probability to predict whether students will drop out of class. The Graph Community Detection model is used to analyze the relationship and interaction mode between learners in cooperative learning. This model has the characteristics of simple structure and accurate prediction.

Author Keywords: MOOC, learning pattern, binary conditional probability, Graph Community Detection model

articleTitle: Design of a Voice Control 6DoF Grasping Robotic arm Based on Ultrasonic Sensor, Computer Vision and Alexa Voice Assistance
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The article presents a study to design a 6-degree of freedom robotic arm which can pick up objects in random positions on a 2D surface based on Arduino microcontroller, ultrasonic sensors and picamera. The robotic arm is able to recognise objects based on computer vision algorithm for shape detection. The ultrasonic sensor measures the distance between the objects and the robotic arm, and the position of the objects in the real world will be detected by its mass centre in the image to improve the accuracy of the pick-up movement. Arduino microcontroller will calculate the rotation angles for the joints of the robotic arm by using inverse kinematics algorithms. The movement of the robotic arm also can be controlled by an Amazon Alexa voice assistance device. The experiment of applying the artificial neural network to control the robotic arm pick-up movement is achieved. The artificial neural network can manipulate the position of the robotic arm to pick up objects after training using the values which are calculated by inverse kinematics equations. The Raspberry Pi is used for processing the computer vision data, and voice commands from Alexa Voice Service based on cloud service.

Author Keywords: robotic arm, computer vision, object detection, artificial neural network, Alexa voice assistance

articleTitle: The Study on the Relationship Among Parenting Style, Negative Perfectionism and Academic Burnout of College Students
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper studied the relationship among parenting style, negative perfectionism and academic burnout of college student. The results show that: (1) Positive parenting style is significantly negatively correlated with academic burnout. Negative parenting style is significantly positively correlated with academic burnout; Negative perfectionism is significantly positively correlated with college students' academic burnout; Negative parenting style and negative perfectionism are significantly positively correlative with each other. (2) Negative perfectionism has a partial mediating role in the relationship between negative parenting style and academic burnout. Negative parenting style affects the individual's academic burnout level through negative perfectionism personality.

articleTitle: Computational Thinking & Practical Thinking Inspired Java Web Curriculum Reform Method
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Both Computational thinking and Practical thinking are important concepts of great concern to the international computer community. They are also hot topics needed to be studied in education. Inspired by these two kinds of thinking, we expound how to better carry out teaching practice. The teaching process is task-oriented, teacher-led and student-centered. In the whole teaching process, teachers use the way of integrating computational thinking with practical thinking to prepare courses, design tasks and guide students to complete learning tasks. Compared with the traditional teaching mode, the teaching mode of integrating computational thinking and practical thinking has made great progress in training students' computer practical ability and innovation ability. It can not only improve learning efficiency, but also train students' computer practical ability. Finally, the feasibility and efficiency of this method are verified by Java Web course design.

articleTitle: Research on New Teaching Platform Under the Background of "Internet +"
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the development of new-generation information technology and the rise of new technologies such as big data and artificial intelligence, the reform and optimization of "Internet +" teaching platform have been promoted. Based on the analysis of mainstream online teaching platforms at home and abroad in the context of "Internet +", this paper puts forward such problems as insufficient course resources for informal education, single teaching form, limited support and service ability, and unbalanced online and offline development. Therefore, through the collaborative development of the content, quantity and form of the course, this paper provides a good learning support service system and online and offline hybrid teaching, while using series of relevant countermeasures such as big data and artificial intelligence new technologies to enhance resource sharing and human-computer interaction capabilities, a new exploration of the new teaching platform are taken under the background of "Internet +".

Author Keywords: Internet +, teaching platform, online and offline hybird teaching

articleTitle: A Method of Extracting Metadata Information in Digital Books
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Metadata is the most important application format in current digital book resources. This paper mainly studies the key technologies and applications of metadata extraction in digital books, and proposes a metadata extraction method using information compensation from web. Experiments show that this method can correct errors of the original extracted metadata to a certain extent, and can also complement the missing metadata.

articleTitle: Design of the Intelligent Internship Management Platform for Vocational Colleges
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The decentralized internship is still the main form of internships in vocational colleges. Many reforms have been carried out to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of decentralized internship management, but there are still many shortcomings need to be fixed. Focus on the characteristic of decentralized internships, we introduced voiceprint recognition, speech recognition, mobile phone location and virtual electric fence technologies to develop the intelligent internship management platform, which can help full-time teachers of vocational colleges to realize the long-distance precisely internship management. Practice proved that our intelligent platform can definitely improve the attendance of interns, enhance the talent training effectiveness, ensure interns' safety, reduce the management costs and reduce teachers' labor intensity.

Author Keywords: internship management, intelligent management platform, voiceprint recognition, virtual electric fence

articleTitle: Applying Learning Analytics to Assess Learning Effect by Using Mobile Learning Support System in U-Learning Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This research proposed a mobile learning support system based on U-learning environment and aimed to design an effective Learning Analytics(LA) model and the essential analytics indicators, so as to apply this LA model to assess learning effect by using mobile learning support system and Augment Reality(AR) learning APP in U-learning environment. The research team launched the first experimental learning for a training program for a total of 408 teachers, who signed up for the learning on the mobile learning support system and AR learning APP in U-learning environment; the paper obtained multi-dimensional data from the mobile learning support system and carried out in-depth learning analytics for the behavioral data of learners in three dimensions of access behavior, interactive behavior and learning effect. From the data analysis and evaluation, the designed learning analytics model and analytics indicators can represent the behavioral characteristics of learners in U-learning environment and provide a relatively systematic and comprehensive data analytics; and the developed mobile learning support system is recognized to be effective for efficient ubiquitous learning.

articleTitle: An Acute Kidney Injury Prediction Model Based on Ensemble Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Acute Kidney Injury (AKI), a common disease in Intensive Care Unit (ICU) patients, is related to high cost, morbidity and mortality. The early prediction of AKI is critical for improving patients' outcome. However, sparse clinical data and highly imbalanced dataset bring great challenges to AKI prediction. Among existed machine learning algorithms, ensemble learning often stands out with its good performance on complex classification problems. Boosting algorithm is one of the best ensemble learning algorithms. Therefore, we develop a prediction model based on it aiming to forecast AKI ahead 24 hours and 48 hours. We also adopt the way that is analogous to text modeling transforming heterogeneous time series reflecting patients' medication information into multidimensional vector to overcome problem brought by sparse data. Additionally, since the imbalanced dataset would affect predictive performance, we artificially construct a more balanced dataset based on the original dataset to initialize the model. According to the experimental results, our model works well on the ICU patients dataset (AUC 24h ahead: 0.80 48h ahead 0.77). We also verify that medication information improves model performance (24h ahead: AUC 0.75 to 0.80 48h ahead: AUC 0.75 to 0.77) and find the optimal ratio of number between classes when initializing model for AKI prediction.

articleTitle: Exploration on Curriculum Teaching Based on OBE and AI
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Curriculum is the core element of talent training. All curricula and teaching activities should be guided by the training goal and serve as the starting point for the achievement of graduation requirements. Based on the outcome-based education (OBE) for engineering education accreditation, this paper probes into the relationship among the training objectives, graduation requirements and curriculum objectives, and clarifies that the curriculum should be optimized by new ideas and new means. With the rapid development of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technology, AI provides a broad prospect and an important technical platform for the implementation of intelligent education. This paper studies the relationship between AI and education, analyzes the applications of AI in the curriculum reform such as MOOC and flip classroom.

articleTitle: The Application of SPOC-Based Deep Learning Model in Psychological Health Education of College Students in Post-MOOC Era
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper introduces the rise, development and popularization of MOOC network education mode to analyze the practical application problems of this education mode in the post-MOOC era, and introduces a deep learning model based on SPOC to explore its application in psychological health education of college students. The course adopts the encrypted form. Students use the password provided by the teacher to enter the MOOC platform to watch the learning video before class, discuss with the classmates in the class, participate in the practical operation, and the teacher gives on-the-spot guidance. The class assessment will take into account online and offline performance. This model aims to optimize the mental health education curriculum of college students by taking advantage of MOOC's rich learning resources and combining the interaction and timeliness of traditional classrooms.

articleTitle: Pulmonary Nodule Segmentation in Computed Tomography with an Encoder-Decoder Architecture
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Precise pulmonary nodule segmentation from computed tomography (CT) images can contribute a lot for both clinical and research purposes while the variability of pulmonary nodules can make it difficult to perform an accurate and robust segmentation. We propose an encoder-decoder architecture which takes great advantages from convolutional neural networks and attains state-of-the-art results on the public LIDC-IDRI dataset. Our proposed method achieves an average Dice-coefficient score of 90.56% and an average surface distance of 0.13 millimeters on a five-fold cross-validation, which surpasses all the present pulmonary nodule segmentation methods on the LIDC-IDRI dataset. Besides, our method is extremely time-efficient with an average time of less than 20 milliseconds segmenting a single nodule using a modern GPU.

articleTitle: Study on Classification Model of Traditional Chinese Medicine Syndrome Types of Stroke Patients in Convalescent Stage Based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: The purpose of this study is to construct a classification diagnosis model for different syndrome types in stroke recovery period, to provide clinical decision support for syndrome diagnosis of stroke recovery period, and to further improve clinical diagnosis efficiency and diagnostic accuracy. Method: We collected a lot of representative medical samples from medical institutions and divided them into training dataset, validating dataset and testing dataset in a 7:2:1 ratio. According to the standards of the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, we use the clinical risk characterization of common Traditional Chinese Medicine in the stroke recovery period as the input variable, and the Traditional Chinese Medicine syndrome type as the output variable. Further, we construct three diagnostic models based on Support Vector Machine for the three types of syndromes: Qi deficiency and blood stasis syndrome, phlegm-stasis in channels, and wind formation from yin deficiency syndrome. To evaluate our solution, we propose to use the TS score as a measure of our models. Results: We achieved a high classification accuracy rate of stroke syndrome: 99.54% for qi deficiency and blood stasis syndrome, 92.06% for phlegm-stasis in channels, and 85.24% for wind formation from yin deficiency syndrome. Conclusion:This diagnostic model of Support Vector Machine has a high accuracy rate. Therefore, our solution has great potential in helping clinical decision making for stroke syndrome.

articleTitle: Big Data Analysis of Differentially Expressed mRNA in Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia Patients with Different Genders
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia is a typical fatal cancer of immature system. Early study found that the incidence and survival time are different in gender. Male patients are in significantly higher risk with poor prognosis. In this paper, we try to find out the different expression in mRNAs between male and female acute lymphoblastic leukemia patients. The mRNA data was downloaded from Therapeutically Applicable Research to Generate Effective Treatment acute lymphoblastic leukemia phase II datasets. Differentially expressed mRNAs were screened by limma R package and R software. Gene ontology of the differentially expressed mRNAs were analyzed by online tool DAVID. And Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes pathway analysis of the dysregulated mRNAs were enriched by clusterProfiler and pathview R package. The relationship between survival rate and dysregulated mRNAs were analyzed by kaplan-meier method and shown in kmplot survival curves. We found that the dysregulated mRNAs in male are related to the high risk of acute lymphoblastic leukemia.

Author Keywords: TARGET, Acute lymphoblastic leukemia, mRNA, gender difference, Big medical data analysis, data mining

articleTitle: Countermeasures for the Development of College Physical Education at the Age of Internet+ Education
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The application of the information technology makes physical education more dynamic. On the base of the researches on the influence of the Internet on the goal and the content, the educators, the educatees and the theoretical structure of physical education, this paper puts forward some countermeasures to deal with the phenomenon, such as renewing education idea, enriching sports information resources, increasing equipment investment in intelligent classrooms, enhancing teachers' information level, promoting students' information literacy, etc. to enhance students' self-learning sports ability, improve the quality of sports teaching and realize the educational goal of physical education.

articleTitle: Improved SPFA Algorithm Based on Cell-Like P System
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Membrane computing is a fast developing natural computing field with wide applications. Cell-like P system is the one of membrane computing and it is a class of distributed and parallel computing model which is inspired from cell. Then, Shortest Path Faster Algorithm is another name of queue optimization algorithm for the Bellman-Ford algorithm. It is usually used to find single-source shortest paths with negative edges and negative weights. In this paper, we use rewrite rules and dissolution rules of cell-like P system, combined with queue thresholds to improve the SPFA algorithm. We use the average distance between the point where the queue is removed and the point to be queued as the threshold. The node whose distance is less than the threshold is inserted at the beginning of the queue, otherwise, the node is inserted at the end of the queue. A directional weighted digraph is applied to prove the feasibility of the algorithm in this paper. This method takes full advantage of the parallelism of the P system and finds the shortest path with fewer steps and shorter time.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Key Generation Scheme Based on CAN Bus
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the widespread use of CAN bus, more and more security issues are exposed. Traditional fixed preset keys are easier to be cracked after long-term use, the risk of key leakage can be caused by physical intrusion; Assigning different keys to different ECUs also leads to extremely high cost of key management . In order to ensure the safety of CAN bus transmission and reduce the complexity of system, this paper proposes a dynamic key generation algorithm. All ECUs obtain their own transient values and current timestamps when the car starts, complete the generation of the master key MK by the ECC algorithm, and generate the current session key in combination with the timestamp to encrypt the message. When the car is turned off, all keys are deleted and regenerated next time when the car starts. It is verified by analysis that the generation scheme can effectively reduce the complexity of key management and improve key security.

articleTitle: Domain Knowledge Model Construction for Interdisciplinary
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the development of Internet information technology, the knowledge of a single subject can no longer meet the needs of the society. In this context, this paper constructs a multidisciplinary interdisciplinary domain knowledge model. According to different needs, the domain knowledge model can be divided into four dimensions: junior college, undergraduate, master and doctor. The domain knowledge of each dimension is different but related to each other. The knowledge model in this field conforms to the needs of social development and plays an important role in personalized recommendation, adaptive learning and other systems.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an English Pronunciation Scoring System for Pupils Based on DNN-HMM
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Nowadays, the problem of poor performance on English pronunciation among Chinese pupils is widespread because of the shortage of foreign teachers, related products and resources. To improve their English pronunciation, we have developed an English word pronunciation scoring system. The system applies DNN-HMMs (deep neural network-hidden Markov models) for acoustic modeling to implement the English speech recognition and the GOP (Goodness of Pronunciation) algorithm for scoring pronunciation based on the likelihood output by DNN-HMMs. The method is implemented on HTK (Hidden Markov Model Toolkit), which integrates a set of tools for building speech recognition system. Moreover, the system is practically deployed, in which the server side conducts the model training; the client side collects pupils' speech data, and feedbacks pupils the inferred scores. Specifically, we collect 150 word pronunciations of 30 pupils as test data and compare the scores given by the system with scores given by teachers. The results demonstrate the reliability of the developed pupil pronunciation scoring system based on DNN-HMM.

Author Keywords: Pupils, English pronunciation scoring, DNN HMM, Goodness of Pronunciation

articleTitle: Investigation and Research on Vocational Education Teachers' Competencies Based on Smart Learning Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The development of vocational education in China has always been concerned and the teachers of vocational education are the main force in training applied works. Smart learning environment puts forward higher requirements for teachers' qualities, this article through the questionnaire survey method, carries on the analysis to the vocational education teacher's present situation. Starting from three aspects of teaching ability, professional ability and vocational analysis ability, the investigation content includes the way, motivation, content, demand and opportunity to improve the quality of vocational education teachers, so as to understand the current situation of the cultivation of vocational education teachers' quality and make the quality of vocational education teachers meet the requirements of smart learning environment.

articleTitle: A Method for Fault Detection of Micro-Motors Based on Wavelet Packet Energy Spectra
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The research proposes a fault detection method for micro-motors based on wavelet packet energy spectra. The vibration signals of micro-motors under different fault types were tested. Afterward, the decomposition and reconstruction algorithm of wavelet packet transform is used to calculate the energy spectra of each sub-band which are then normalized. The energy changes of signals in each frequency band contain abundant information on the operation state of micro-motors. The energy of signals in different frequency bands shows significant differences under normal and fault conditions. With the eigenvectors built based on frequency-band energy spectra, the mapping relation from the energy change to fault can be constructed. The preliminary experimental results demonstrate that wavelet packet energy spectra can be applied to fault detection of micro-motors.

articleTitle: Color Space Volume and Superpixel Based Leukocyte Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel method based on color space volume and multimodal histogram thresholding (MHT) for leukocyte segmentation in human blood smear images under the rapid staining condition. The proposed method first defines a new color space volume to highlight the leukocyte's nucleus region, and it then uses the MHT method to extract the nucleus. Then, the proposed method takes the central region in the superpixel segmentation result as an initial leukocyte region, and it then uses the MHT method to extract the leukocyte region. Finally, the cytoplasm is obtained by subtracting the nucleus region from the leukocyte region. Experimental results on a dataset containing 300 leukocyte images under rapid staining condition show that the proposed method provides a higher segmentation accuracy than the counterparts.

Author Keywords: leukocyte segmentation, superpixel segmentation, color space volume, histogram thresholding

articleTitle: License Plate Location Based on Combination of Deep Learning and Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: License plate location is the key step of license plate recognition. In order to improve the precision of license plate location, a license plate location method based on deep learning and feature fusion is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the color feature of license plate is extracted by histogram backprojection method, and the texture feature of license plate is extracted by Sobel Operator. Combining these two kinds of features, the obtained connectivity regions are used as the candidate regions of license plate. And then ResNet20 convolutional neural network is used to identify the candidate regions and locate the license plate. The test results show that the method can satisfy the precise license plate location under the different shooting angles and illuminations, and lay a foundation for improving the accuracy and robustness of license plate recognition in the future.

articleTitle: An Improved Multi-objective Immune Algorithm Based on Differential Evolution
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an improved multi-objective immune algorithm based on differential evolution, named DE-MOIA. In recent years, the multi-objective immune algorithm (MOIA) has shown promising performance in solving multi-objective optimization problems. However, existing MOIAs still have difficulties to obtain high quality results. In order to find a set of solutions that closely approximate the Pareto-optimal front (PF), we present DE-MOIA, which uses two differential evolution strategies and an adaptive mutation operator. We performed experiments using eight benchmark multi-objective problems. In order to validate the effectiveness of our algorithm, we compared DE-MOIA with three multi-objective evolutionary algorithms (MOEAs) and a multi-objective immune algorithm (MOIA) on three performance metrics. Experimental results show that our algorithm performs better than other algorithms.

articleTitle: Development of Mobile Learning System Based on WeChat Public Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Mobile Learning System (MLS) plays an important role in supporting mobile learning and how to develop the MLS effectively has attracted extensive attentions from researchers and engineers. However, existing works often have the problems of high development costs and difficult promotion. Aiming at these problems, we propose to develop the MLS based on WeChat public platform, which is an emerging development platform used for developing mobile business application system. We present the design scheme of the MLS based on WeChat public platform in detail, including system architecture, functions framework and database model. Besides, we also give the corresponding implementations of some core functions of the MLS. By developing the MLS using WeChat public platform, we find that this way can reducing the development cost of the MLS effectively. Moreover, the MLS can also be promoted easily among a large number of WeChat users.

Author Keywords: mobile learning system, WeChat public platform, mobile business application system

articleTitle: Research on the Mixed Teaching Mode of Emergency Medicine Based on Blackboard Network Teaching Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Research purposes: Because emergency medicine requires highly demanding operability, based on the study of the Blackboard network teaching platform and emergency medicine mixed teaching model, the theory and practice are combined. The proposed method is to analyze the mixed medical teaching mode of emergency medicine based on Blackboard network teaching platform through the construction of emergency medical video course website, classroom assisted teaching, after-school continuous teaching and its use evaluation. Results: Compared with the modern general teaching mode, the Blackboard network teaching platform's emergency medical mixed teaching mode has changed the traditional emergency medical teaching methods, paying more attention to the functions of communication, counseling, consultation, evaluation, etc. in teaching, for the development of high quality Emergency medicine teaching provides powerful material and technical conditions and plays an important role in clinical medical education. Conclusion: The hybrid medical teaching model based on Blackboard network teaching platform is constructed, which greatly improves the hands-on ability, logical thinking ability and independent analysis ability of medical students, and lays a foundation for cultivating emergency medical talents with clinical practice ability.

articleTitle: Emerging Research Trends and Development of Alcoholic Liver Disease Based on Bibliometrics and Visualizaed Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: We conduct a scientometric study on the literature of the liver disease caused by alcohol from 2009 to 2019. Four related data sets of publications relevant to the liver disease caused by alcohol are constructed through four different topic searches and citation expansion to ensure adequate coverage of the field. Based on a combined data set of 5,257 articles published between 2009 and the first five months of 2019, networks of co-cited references representing the literature of the liver disease caused by alcohol are constructed and visualized. Structure and temporal dynamics are identified in terms of the most active topical areas and cited references. We also discover new developments which are identified in terms of newly emerged clusters and research areas. Through the literature coupling analysis and clustering analysis, we further explore the major and young research clusters in the field. With CiteSpace, through a series of visual methods for information measurement, we will explore the emerging trends and developments in the field.

articleTitle: Prototype Implementation of Traditional Chinese Medicine Quality Traceability System Based on Two-Dimensional Barcode
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: A prototype of the quality traceability system of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) based on two-dimensional barcode using mobile intelligent technology was designed and developed. Methods: Through reviewing the current major tracing technologies and traceability systems, the layered design of TCM quality traceability system based on two-dimensional code was presented, based on which a prototype system was implemented through web server and mobile application development. Results: This system was expected to break through the limitations of most of the original traceability systems, it can not only trace external information on origin, circulation and processing, but can also track the intrinsic quality change of TCM. Conclusion: This study provides a theoretical basis for the establishment of quality traceability system of TCM using mobile intelligent technology.

Author Keywords: Chemical Fingerprints of TCM, Quality Traceability of TCM, 2D Code of TCM Quality, Mobile Traceability System of TCM

articleTitle: Computer Assisted Regularity Analysis for the Law on Medication of Treating Qi Deficiency Type Coronary Heart Disease by Distinguished Veteran Traditional Chinese Medicine Doctors
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective To analyze the law on medication in the treatment of qi deficiency type coronary heart disease by distinguished veteran traditional Chinese medicine doctors with statistical methods. Methods 200 cases of qi deficiency type coronary heart disease treated with distinguished veteran traditional Chinese medicine doctor after 1980s were recorded in the analyzing system and the medication frequency chart was set up, take deficiency of qi as dependent variable and Chinese medicines as independent variable for logistic regression analysis by Statistics Analysis System. Results Of 200 cases, 195 kinds of Chinese medicines were used, in which, the frequency of astragalus, salvia miltiorrhiza, ligusticum wallichii, safflower, angelica sinensis, codonopsis pilosula were high; Logistic regression analysis of astragalus, safflower, corydalis have statistical significance. Conclusion The study discovers that reinforce functional activities of the heart, invigorate the circulation of blood and qi are the most common principles in the treatment of qi deficiency type coronary heart disease. The medicines that have higher specificity for treating qi deficiency type coronary heart disease are the 3 Chinese medicines that involved in the logistic regression analysis. This study shows the method and law on medication that distinguished veteran traditional Chinese medicine doctors treating qi deficiency type coronary heart disease and accompanied symptom, and some Chinese medicines which have higher specificity. It has a certain guiding significance in clinical practice.

articleTitle: Research on the Co-construction and Sharing of Teaching Resources Under the "Internet Plus" Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the in-depth advancement of education informatization, the impact of the co-construction and sharing of teaching resources in the "Internet plus" environment has exerted an increasingly profound influence on the teaching mode and learning mode. Its development provided an opportunity for mixed teaching and triggered a new round of educational change. This paper expounds the research status and significance of resource co-construction and sharing at home and abroad, and analyses and summarizes the problems of weak awareness of co-construction and sharing, insufficient high-quality resources and low utilization rate of dynamic resources. Subsequently, with reference to the construction of iStudy teaching platform, this paper proposes a solution that multiple mechanisms coexist around the co-construction and sharing of resources, and uses the points system to build a coconstruction and sharing system of mutual benefit and mutual assistance. It is advocated to standardize the classification of resources and make full use of dynamic resources with the help of big data, so as to promote the development of educational informatization.

Author Keywords: teaching resourses, co construction and sharing, Internet plus, iStudy teaching platform

articleTitle: Data Mining in Cognitive Function Training of Depression Patients Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To study how to use virtual reality technology (VR) to improve the cognitive function of depressive patients. This study explored the process of the diagnosis, training and evaluation of cognitive impairment in patients with depression, and provided new training methods and research ideas for improving cognitive impairment and prognosis of patients with depression. Methods: 30 mild to moderate depression subjects were randomly assigned to the experimental group, and 32 mild to moderate depression subjects were randomly assigned to the control group. The subjects in the experimental group were trained and treated with immersion virtual reality system for six months, while the subjects in the control group did not receive any treatment. MoCA scale and corresponding diagnostic criteria were used to assess the cognitive baseline level before treatment and the cognitive improvement after treatment. Result: The subjects in this study had mild to moderate depression, and the depression was similar in different genders, professions and groups. Before the cognitive training, there was no difference in the scores of MoCA scale between the experimental group and the control group, t = 0.2, P = 0.84. After the cognitive training, there was a significant difference in the scores of MoCA scale between the experimental group and the control group, t = 4.36, P = 0.00. This shows that the cognitive function training and treatment based on VR technology can effectively improve the cognitive level of depressive patients. Conclusion: Using virtual reality technology to train the cognitive ability of mild to moderate depression subjects can significantly improve the cognitive ability of the subjects, which is worthy of clinical application and promotion.

articleTitle: Research on Adaptive Learning System Based on Three Core Modules
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Adaptive learning system is a highly intelligent learning resource service model. It can provide learners with personalized learning paths and learning resources, and improve learning by combining specific behavioral characteristics such as user learning habits, learning methods and knowledge capacity, make each student can have his own "exclusive teacher."This paper focuses on the three core modules of the adaptive learning system-the knowledge network model, the cognitive level model and the adaptive recommendation model. Firstly, based on Ebbinghaus memory theory, students' memory rules are explored; knowledge network model is constructed by knowledge graph to build knowledge trees; dual-subject recommendation mechanism is adopted in adaptive recommendation models to integrate users and systems. Secondly, this paper designs a knowledge network construction method suitable for describing and demonstrating the characteristics of university courses, that is, using the knowledge tree to visualize knowledge points. Finally, this paper designs a representation method that can effectively distinguish the knowledge of different students. When using clustering and lag sequential analysis to determine the cognitive level of students, the "red and green traffic lights" form is used to grasp the knowledge points. This is also an element labeling method to reflect the progress of learning more vividly. The research results show that the resulting three-core module has better performance and higher adaptability. The conclusions of this study help to establish a relatively complete adaptive learning system to promote students' self-learning.

articleTitle: An Allocation Scheme of Students Based on IPM Under the Nearby Enrollment Policy
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Under the policy of delimiting area to recruit students and nearby enrollment, this paper mainly solves the problem of rational allocation of students in some urban districts. Firstly, this paper puts forward the problem of the allocation of primary school students, which need to be solved urgently in the context of the reconstruction of the old city and the construction of the new city. Then, based on factors such as the quality of students, the safety of students, the management of students and interests of the schools, an integer programming model for the rational allocation of urban students is established. Finally, the optimal allocation scheme is given by Lingo software which provides a theoretical basis for relevant decision makers.

articleTitle: SWOT Analysis of Health Management Development in the Context of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In order to ensure better and faster development of health management in the era of big data, this study uses SWOT analysis method to analyze the strengths, weeknesses, opportunities and threats of health management in the context of big data, and from that comes corresponding SO strategy, ST strategy, WO strategy and WT strategy. Finally, it comes to the conclusion that we should make full use of the advantages of big data to promote the development of health management.

articleTitle: Analysis and Inspiration of Current Situation of Innovative Maker Education in Secondary Vocational Schools in the Internet + Era
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In the context of "Internet +", secondary vocational schools are exploring a new model of maker education by integrating resources such as computer networks with the spirit of educational innovation. In this paper, taking Jinan sixth vocational secondary school as an example, this paper analyzes the feasibility, development status, teaching characteristics and existing problems of the maker education of secondary vocational schools. Based on this, some inspirations for better developer maker education are put forward: creating a maker educational culture atmosphere, creating maker space, improving teachers' teaching level, and education reform and curriculum and evaluation system.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Students' Answered Record Analyze Model and Question Automatic Classify Based on K-Means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In the era of smart education, computer assisted instruction (CAI) has been a hot research topic in the field of smart education. In the current study, most of the questions answered by students are summarized and classified by labor. The teachers classify the students' scores by hand according to the students' answer records in the examination, and then propose individualized instructional programs for students of the same type in view of their deficiencies in the knowledge points corresponding to the exam. Due to the large workload and the influence of teachers' experience, it is difficult to guarantee the efficiency and quality of manually classifying students' answered records. In the paper, we propose a model named CMD based on K-means clustering algorithm in order to analysis students' answer record. The model can automatically classify the test questions according to correct or wrong, modified times and the difficulty level of the students' answers. The experimental result shows that the CMD model can effectively realize the automatic classification of test questions, which not only reduces the labor consumption of teachers, but also has high accuracy.

articleTitle: Docker's Security Analysis of Using Control Group to Enhance Container Resistance to Pressure
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Docker is a container technology to create lightweight virtual system framework in the cloud computing environment. Massive users exploit it on systems of Linux, Mac, and Windows to simplify configuration or test large-scale operations and isolate applications. However, considering the security of Docker container, Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks have been a severe problem which needs to be solved. Therefore, this paper aims to analyze the compressive ability of Docker container and reduce the influence of DDoS by using Control group (Cgroup). Furthermore, an experiment will be designed to detect the effects of Cgroup under three kinds of pressure: run out Central Process Unit (CPU), run out bandwidth and DDoS attack. In addition, limiting CPU, limiting Network (Net) I/O and limiting both of them will be considered as the method to use Cgroup to restrict containers' resources. In a result, it is shown that the attacks would be limited in a certain scope after restricting the resources of containers by Cgroup. Therefore, the method of imposing restrictions on CPU and Net I/O resources of Docker containers by using Cgroup can effectively reduce the impact of DDoS attacks.

articleTitle: Application of Microlectures Based on WeChat in Rehabilitation Nursing Teaching
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objectives: To explore the application of microlectures based on WeChat in rehabilitation nursing teaching. Methods: Make microlectures and create WeChat group. A nursing class was randomly selected as the experimental group and the other one as the control group. The experimental group adopted WeChat-based microlectures in teaching, while the control group adopted traditional teaching methods. Observe and compare the teaching effect. Results: In the experimental group, the knowledge mastery, course preference, and the scores of theoretical and skilled examinations were higher. The difference between the experimental group and the control group was statistically significant. Conclusions: The microlectures based on WeChat in teaching can not only improve the teaching quality and teaching efficiency, but also arouse the enthusiasm of students to learn, and promote the improvement of students' communication ability.

articleTitle: Research on the Management of Live Classroom in Colleges and Universities Based on the Theory of Contingency
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the rapid development of technology, live broadcast has been widely used in teaching. However, there are many problems in the management of live classrooms. The contingency theory believes that there is no management method applicable to any environment. This paper divides the live classrooms into online live classrooms, double teacher live classrooms, and live classrooms in smart classrooms, different types of live classrooms were managed in different ways. Compared with the unified management methods, the teaching result of differentiated management is better.

articleTitle: Anisotropic Laplace-Beltrami Operators for Non-Rigid 3D Shape Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Anisotropic diffusion has been used as an effective approach for mesh processing. Traditional Laplace-Beltrami operator is based on the diffusion theory, but it does not reflect the anisotropic diffusion. In addition, most methods are based on the Laplace-Beltrami operator(LBO) when calculating point descriptor in many non-rigid 3D shape analysis and retrieval tasks. In order to overcome these limitations, in this paper, we propose nonlinear anisotropic Laplace-Beltrami operators(NALBO) which can be used for applications such as non-rigid 3D shape analysis and retrieval. First of all, we propose the new tensor and incorporate extrinsic information into it. Based on the new tensor, we can transform the gradient domain from one space to another. It can improve the accuracy of point signature. Then, We established the discretization scheme of the anisotropic Laplace-Beltrami operators. Finally, our anisotropic Laplace-Beltrami operator is applied to the non-rigid 3D shape retrieval task. The experimental results turn out that our anisotropic Laplace-Beltrami operator is feasible and efficient for tasks such as non-rigid 3D shape matching and retrieval, etc.

Author Keywords: non rigid 3D shape retrieval, Laplace-Beltrami operator, curvature, point signature, discretization,

articleTitle: Analysis of the Curriculum Reform Method Based on the Combination of Computational Thinking and Engineering Thinking
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The software design pattern is an important core course for software engineering. However, the traditional classroom teaching method only focuses on the teaching of technical knowledge, but ignores the importance of thinking ability. In order to develop students' "computational thinking" and "engineering thinking" ability to combine the Exploration curriculum reform teaching methods paper from the main body, teaching content, teaching methods and evaluation of the four aspects of the course, presents a concrete and feasible teaching development program that combines "computational thinking" with "engineering thinking".

Author Keywords: computational thinking, Engineering thinking, Software Development, Design pattern, programming, Education Mode Research,

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Teaching System for Higher Vocational Specialty Courses Based on Hybrid Teaching Mode
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In recent years, with the diversified development of education and training in China and the continuous "Internet +", enterprises and society have put forward higher requirements for the ability of skilled talents. However, in the vocational specialty colleges that transport a large number of skilled talents, it is increasingly difficult to meet the needs of students' learning and development. At the same time, it is difficult for students to select appropriate content for independent learning in the vast information on the Internet. Hybrid teaching is a teaching mode that combines the advantages of both traditional teaching and networked teaching. The specialty courses teaching system is based on hybrid teaching mode. It uses Java Web technology as the basis for adopting B/S development mode, MySQL database and eclipse, Navicat as Development tools. The research and implementation of the hybrid teaching system is conducive to the school to help bridging the communication between the students and the enterprise, so that students can learn more directly and provide high-skilled talents with basic professional knowledge and skilled skills. On the other hand, through practice, it also helps to promote the development of hybrid teaching reform, thus solving the complexity and particularity of the informationization process in higher vocational colleges.

Author Keywords: hybrid teaching, specialty courses, teaching system, information technology, Java web

articleTitle: A Multi-population Genetic Algorithm Based on Dynamic P System for Solving Constrained Optimization Problems
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Constrained optimization problems (COPs) which can be seen everywhere in life has been widely used in science and engineering. Given the complexity of this problem, it is difficult to solve them with traditional optimization techniques. In this paper, we have applied a new algorithm which is called Multi-population genetic algorithm (MPGA) based on an improved dynamic cell-like P system. This algorithm combines global search and local search, and have a significant effect on overcoming immature convergence problem. The sensitivity of calculated results to genetic control parameters is greatly reduced. We have also used Taguchi methods to select the initial population to reduce the number of iterations. The performance is tested on several well-known engineering design problems. This research can be applied in most practical problems and is of great help to optimize the operation.

articleTitle: Analysis of Factors Affecting Attraction of Medical Teaching Content Based on WeChat Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objectives: Taking the teaching in "Rehabilitation Nursing" carried out in our school as an example, the data research and qualitative analysis were performed to discuss the influence of the factors, such as push time, the number of title characters, media richness and subject content, on the effect of medical teaching based on WeChat platform. Methods: Choosing four variables: push time, title characters number, media richness and subject content, the concept model of influencing factors of attraction degree of medical teaching articles is constructed, and the correlation analysis is carried out by logging in to the background of WeChat management to obtain the relevant data. Results: The reading rate was 91.22% on the first day, 131.62% on the seventh day, and the simple correlation coefficient between the reading rate and the number of title characters was -0.234. When the topic content is a basic skill, the probability of correlation coefficient test between reading rate and media richness is 0.039, and the one-way ANOVA p value of subject content and reading rate is 0.026. Conclusions: The closer the class time is, the higher the reading rate of the article is. The reading rate of pushing articles in advance is greatly influenced by the content of the articles. There is a negative correlation between the number of characters in the title and the reading rate of the article, and it is a weak correlation, the influence of which is not significant. The media richness has a weak influence on the reading rate, and the content of the article has a greater influence on the reading rate. The students are more concerned about the content that may be discussed in the classroom and prefer to read enlightening original articles.

articleTitle: Monitoring Function Design of Radio Monitoring Management System Based on C/S Architecture
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Radio engineering has become one of the main channels for human beings to obtain and disseminate information. Radio resources are easily contaminated. Harmful radio sources can disrupt the order of the air. Radio monitoring and management system with integrated management capability can effectively manage radio information. This paper used C++ language, combined with SQLite database, developed the task monitoring function module of radio monitoring management system. It solves the shortcomings of existing radio monitoring and management system, such as the monitoring function is not perfect, data-sharing capabilities are weak, software compatibility is low, software upgrades lack flexibility. After many researches, this system realizes real-time monitoring, full-time monitoring and timing monitoring functions.

articleTitle: A Method to Locate and Recognize LCD Display Screen using FCN
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This article proposed a more robust and universal method to locate the no-backlight LCD screen and recognize the number on the screen. It can work well in complex background and uneven illumination. The system uses a semantic segmentation neural network based on residual network to locate and segment the screen area roughly, then use the roughly segmentation and edge information of image to cut the screen area accurately. After these steps, the screen area will be rectification. Finally cut the characters and recognize them using CNN.

articleTitle: Hotspots Analysis and Its Applications in Vocational Education with CiteSpace
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
