abstract: Vocational education is an important part in modern education and its teaching methods appear distinguishing characters. In recent years, the research on teaching models in vocational education has attracted great attention and obtained significant achievements. In this paper, the knowledge mapping software of CiteSpace is introduced to bibliometric analyze and study the hotspots in vocational education based on the data from the China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI). With the visualizations on knowledge maps including institutional cooperation, author cooperation, keyword co-occurrence and time zone map, the development veins of vocational education is explored, the frontiers and research focus on vocational education are achieved. Finally, the research results are applied to practical teaching mode in the course of Python Programming. The results of the teaching practice show that studying passion is promoted and the effect of teaching are improved in the class with novel teaching mode.

articleTitle: An Auxiliary Scheme for Automatic Marking of Chinese Reading Comprehension
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The traditional manual marking has problems such as high time consuming and tedious process, especially for the review of subjective questions such as reading comprehension. Fortunately, the rapid development of information technology brings us many new concepts such as deep learning, machine learning and educational big data, which are profoundly changing the traditional teaching methods and further promoting the development of education developing towards the direction of modernization, informatization and intelligence. So, this paper proposes an auxiliary scheme for automatic scoring of Chinese reading comprehension for reducing unnecessary costs in the education process. Our scheme utilizes an improved LSTM neural network for keyword extraction and adopts word embedding for semantic information extraction. Firstly, we segment Chinese words and divide the text content into meaningful word strings. Then, the neural network is used to obtain keywords of the solution and a student's answer corresponding to the question. Finally, we exert the cw2vec word embedding method to capture the semantic information and calculate the semantic similarity between these keywords. Therefore, our method can assist the automatic scoring process. We verify the effectiveness of our method with comparing experiments.

articleTitle: A Sensor Data Processing and Storage Method for Wireless Body Area Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper proposes an adaptive processing method and a dynamic storage method of pulsed wave signal based on wireless body area network. Firstly, the ZigBee star network model is adopted as the basic network architecture of the system. Secondly, an adaptive Gaussian filter model is designed to eliminate the influence of environmental and man-made factors. Finally, the dynamic storage algorithm is used to map the pulsed wave signal to a new stored sample, and the regression model is used to restore the new sample to the original signal. Simulation experiments show that: 1) The adaptive Gaussian model minimizes the signal noise and better maintains the characteristics of the pulsed wave signal. 2) On the premise of using ARIMA regression model of neural network, dynamic storage algorithm improves the regression accuracy compared with fixed storage algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Relevance Analysis and Clustering Algorithms in College Students' Academic Performance
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of contemporary college students' academic achievements, the K-means clustering analysis algorithm is used to analyze the correlation between library learning behavior and academic achievement GPA. The experimental results show that students' academic performance evaluation should be based on many factors and put forward Suggestions for improving college students' academic performance.

articleTitle: Analysis on Hotspots of International Scientific Data Management and Sharing Based on Informetrics Atlas
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This research aims to track hotspots of international scientific data management and sharing. The method of informetric analysis is applied in this paper. CitespaceV, an information visualization software, is utilized to quantitatively analyze the relevant subject literature. By analyzing knowledge atlas and studying key articles, the research draws the following result: current research hotspots include theory-oriented research based on open science, service-oriented practice of university libraries, application-oriented expansion of emerging areas, integrated discipline research methods and technology-oriented research.

articleTitle: Cardiac Ectopic Thyroid a Case Report and Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The ectopic thyroid gland is an abnormal development of the embryo. The thyroid gland does not appear in other parts of the neck, such as the pharynx, the tongue, the hyoid bone, the subgut, the anterior larynx, the sternum, the trachea, the esophagus, the sternum, and rearly chest, etc. Most of the ectopic thyroid occurs in the path around the thyroglossal duct or on the lateral side of the neck. The thyroid gland, which is located at the base of the tongue, is the most common ectopic thyroid gland, followed by the lingual bone and its upper and lower levels. However, ectopic thyroid occurs in the heart, which is rare. Since the 1980s, there have been only 20 cases in the world, while only 2 cases have been reported in China. Below we report a case of patient with a cardiac ectopic thyroid.

articleTitle: Evaluation Model of Acute Mountain Sickness Based on item Response Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The acute mountain sickness caused by high altitude, low pressure and anoxic environment have seriously affected the health and life safety of people rushing into the plateau. Acute altitude sickness is the key point of medical treatment on the plateau, and it is also an important subject of mathematical research. In this paper, based on item response theory, the evaluation model of acute plateau disease is constructed by using binomial logistic model, and the goodness of fitting, global significance and prediction accuracy of the model were tested by statistical software, realized in theory of acute mountain sickness is a kind of judgment.

articleTitle: Study on The Growth of Collaborative Knowledge Building Community Supported by BLEs
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of informatization teaching conditions, The ubiquitous blended learning environment which combined by intelligent mobile devices and campus wireless networks is very popular in Chinese higher education. The ubiquitous blended learning environment, with its special advantages, supports the learner's proactive collaborative inquiry process and the development of the learning community. This paper explores the growth of collaborative knowledge building community in blended learning environments based on the perspective of social network analysis.

articleTitle: A Novel Method of Detecting Microangioma in Retinal Image Based on Visual Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy (DR), an ocular complication of diabetes could threaten vision, has become one of the common causes of blindness in adults' working age. The detection of microangioma (MA), the first feature and persists with the development of DR, is an important step in the diagnosis and follow-up of DR. However, due to complexity of retinal image and the randomness of abnormal lesions, the detection of MA is more susceptible to the influence of background texture noise and other structures in retinal image. A novel method for detecting MA based on visual features is proposed. It establishes an observation function and uses multi-range mean filtering to eliminate texture noise and vascular network. Then, the detection target is confirmed by the visual shape features. A series of tests in the different public retinal images databases show that the proposed method is effective and would be useful for computer-aided diagnosis of early screening of DR.

articleTitle: Research on the Satisfaction of College Students' Payment Online Education Based on IPA and KANO Model
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This study combines qualitative analysis with quantitative model. 44 college students were selected as interviewees. The qualitative analysis was carried out by NVivo. The main influencing factors of online payment education behavior of five users were extracted and questionnaires were sent out. Using 242 valid questionnaires collected, combined with Kano model and IPA analysis, the influencing factors model of satisfaction is constructed, and the user needs are prioritized and relevant suggestions are given. The results show that curriculum system, communication, interaction, and teachers are indispensable quality elements, one-dimensional quality elements and charm quality elements to enhance user satisfaction, respectively, while the performance of the system is indifferent quality elements.

Author Keywords: Online education, Qualitative study of satisfaction, Kano model, IPA analysis Introduction

articleTitle: Clinical Study on Neck Pain of Cervical Spondylosis Treated with Different Doses of Jing Moxibustion
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To evaluate the short-term efficacy and safety of moxibustion with different dose in treating neck pain of cervical spondylosis by randomized controlled study, and to explore the dose effect relationship of moxibustion therapy. Method: The two groups selected the same point, the treatment group moxibustion to patients with special moxibustion sensation (such as conductive heat, other non-thermal sensation, etc.), the control group moxibustion operation with the treatment group, each point for 7 does treatment. Every three days, the interval of treatment was more than 72 hours. Subjects received treatment twice a week. Eight treatments were completed as one course of treatment. The main outcome indicators were Northwick Park scale. Result: The cure rate was 10% in the treatment group, the effective rate was 93.33%, the cure rate of the control group was 0%, the effective rate was 83.33%. Comparison between the two groups by rank and test, the difference was statistically significant. Conclusion: Jing moxibustion has a good short-term and medium-term effect on cervical spondylosis, which can improve the quality of life of patients, and suggest that moxibustion sensation and skin reaction degree are reasonable dimensions of moxibustion control.

articleTitle: Course Knowledge Graph Review
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In recent years, researches based on knowledge graph have attracted widespread attention from various fields. Taking the application of knowledge graph in pedagogy as an example, this study firstly introduces the significance, value and status quo of the course knowledge graph research, and then expounds and analyzes the application of knowledge graph in different courses in China.

articleTitle: Target Classification System Based on Target Detection for Students' Classroom Assessment
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Classroom assessment is an evaluation system which combines deep learning techniques with traditional teaching theories. Deep learning is a kind of representation learning, which is used to extract feature. In this paper, the convolutional neural network (CNN) is used to extract the features of an image. The careful and careless states of the students are identified. All faces are located by a rectangular frame. This paper uses a real-time camera to collect training data and test data. The target detection model mainly includes YOLO (You Only Look Once) and Mask R-CNN. The former is mainly used for classification and calibration targets, and the latter is mainly used for semantic segmentation. This paper also uses a cross-platform software architecture, which includes the Android and the PC.

articleTitle: Teaching Practice and Thinking of Programming Courses
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The purpose of the computer programming class is to improve students' ability to analyze and solve problems, and ultimately improve students' programming skills. From many years of teaching experience, we can see that students can easily understand theoretical or algorithmic ideas, but once it comes to programming, there is no way to do so. This article focuses on how to implement ideas into programming implementation in the course of programming and data structure. We hope it can provide some reference for the teaching of programming courses.

articleTitle: Clinical Evaluation Method for Medical Devices Based on Multi-Objective
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In order to realize the rapid and accurate evaluation of new medical devices, this paper puts forward a specific evaluation method for the clinical effect of medical devices based on clinical data. A multi-objective evaluation model is designed for scientific and normative evaluation of multiple performances of multiple medical devices simultaneously by converting clinical data into medical device evaluation data. The simulated calculation result shows that the method is practical and effective to evaluate whether a medical device can or cannot achieve its intended/designed function.

articleTitle: Clinical Study on Vocal Nodule and Vocal Polyp Treated by Traditional Chinese Medicine Compound
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective to investigate the effect of traditional Chinese medicine on vocal nodules and vocal polyps. Methods: 102 patients with vocal cord tumors, including 53 patients with vocal cord polyps and 49 patients with vocal cord nodules, were randomly divided into the treatment group and the control group. Both groups had a course of treatment of 65d. Results: The total effective rate was 100% in the treatment group and 52.1% in the control group (P <; 0.05). The therapeutic effect of vocal nodules was 92% in the treatment group and 66.6% in the control group (P <; 0.05). Conclusion: the treatment of vocal cord tumors with traditional Chinese medicine composition is safe and effective in treating vocal cord nodules and vocal cord polyps, providing a good idea and method for the prevention and treatment of vocal cord tumors with traditional Chinese medicine.

Author Keywords: traditional Chinese medicine compound for treatment of vocal cord tumor

articleTitle: Cooperative Education in Construction of Computer Experiment-Teaching Demonstration Center
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: A cooperative education with the features of multi-level, multi-module and open-ended mode is described for the construction of computer experiment-teaching demonstration Center (CETDC) in this paper, which combines classroom knowledges with practical operations in discipline competitions and corporations. The guiding ideology, architecture and management mode of CETDC are proposed with the analysis of cooperative education on the practical ability and creative quality of students. It is manifested by investigations that CETDC based on cooperative education can supply an effective platform for students to improve their innovative and practical outcomes.

articleTitle: Jingshu Keli in Treatment of Cervical Spondylotic Radiculopathy (CSR): A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: To review the curative effects and safety of Jingshu Keli on Cervical spondylotic radiculopathy. Methods: A systematic literature search of electronic databases (PubMed, Embase, CENTRAL and Chinese database) was conducted for randomized controlled trials comparing Jingshu Keli with other treatments in CSR patients. Literature collected in this paper was published up to May 2019, and random effects meta-analyses were performed by RevMen 5.3 software. Result: There were 17 RCT enclosed. Results showed that: 1 The total effect in treatment groups were better than blank control groups [OR=4.03, 95%CI(1.27, 12.84)]. Compared with other drugs and physical therapy treatments, the treatment of cervical spondylotic radiculopathy has no advantage[OR=0.54, 95%CI(0.29, 1.00)], [OR=0.33, 95%CI(0.16, 0.67)]. 2 The VAS scores in treatment groups were better than in blank control groups [MD=0.96, 95%CI(0.74,1.17)], compared with other drugs groups, the efficacy was comparable [MD=0.14, 95%ci (-0.09,0.37)], and there was no advantage compared with physiotherapy groups[MD=-0.70, 95%CI(-1.03,-0.37)]. 3 There was no statistically significant difference between two groups of the incidence of adverse reactions[OR=1.01, 95%CI(0.43,2.41)]. Conclusion: Jingshu Keli is effective in treating cervical spondylotic radiculopathy.

Author Keywords: Jingshu Keli, Cervical spondylotic radiculopathy, Meta-analysis

articleTitle: Research on Embedded Library Services in University for Scientific Research Users
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In the big data environment, with scientific research process getting more and more digital, the information needs and behavior of scientific research users have changed a lot. In this case, the modes and contents of library knowledge services should be adjusted accordingly. In order to establish the library knowledge service mode which can better meet the research requirement of universities in the big data era, the paper aims to provide more innovative ideas for it. While traditional libraries mainly provide users with the information services through offering the required resources, libraries in the new information environment should not only provide targeted documents during the users' entire research process, but also offer solutions for their specific problems, as well as specialized knowledge services. In this paper, bibliometrics, survey research and analysis method are applied to dissect the research status of university-oriented knowledge services, and the problems and its causes in the service process have also been expounded. The conclusion is that university libraries should re-allocate their resources from the perspective of digital scientific research, transform the scientific research service model with knowledge services embedded into the whole process of the scientific research, so as to help researchers to create knowledge more effectively and meet the requirements of informational scientific research and academic forums.

articleTitle: Query Reconstruction in Medical Case Description Using Query Performance Predictors
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: As an important branch of clinical decision support track, medical literature retrieval receives the electronic medical record as an input to obtain the acquired information from a large amount of medical literature. However, the description of clinical record is rather complicated and ambiguous in semantic way, therefore it is necessary for us to perform query reconstruction for a better retrieval performance. In this paper, we take the advantage of query quality predictors to process long clinical notes with redundant content, and predict query intent to reconstruct the original query. Experimental results on the standard Text REtrieval Conference (TREC) CDS track dataset confirm the superior performance of the proposed method.

Author Keywords: clinical decision support, query reduction, query reconstruction

articleTitle: A Model for Analyzing Students' Mastery of Knowledge Points
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Deeply mining the detailed data in the process of students' examination plays an important role in studying students' learning characteristics and realizing individualized learning. Due to the association between test questions mostly given by experts, the number of choosing path length on each question in the process of answering questions can not be accurately collected. In this paper, we propose a model named MASMKP(A Model for Analyzing Students' Mastery of Knowledge Points) based on text analysis in order to combine the examination questions with the knowledge points they belong to. By analyzing the relationship between the questions and combining the number of choosing path length on each question in the process of answering the questions, we can get the students' mastery of the knowledge points. Depending on this model, the text features of test questions are extracted firstly, and the test questions are classified into knowledge points according to the classification model. Then the number of choosing path length on each question is converted to the number of choosing path length on each knowledge point. The number of choosing path length reflects the students' mastery of the knowledge point to a certain extent. Students are clustered according to their mastery of each knowledge point using k-means algorithm, then students with different characteristics are obtained and personalized teaching is realized. The experimental results show that this model can extract and classify the features of students, and the accuracy and validity of this model are verified.

articleTitle: Construction of Curriculum System for Automation Based on Complicated Project Problems
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Cultivating students with the ability to solve complicated engineering problems isn't only important for engineering education professional certification (EDPC), but also for higher engineering education in China. Taken the major of automation in Wuhan University of Science and Technology as an example, a curriculum system is implemented on the basis of ideas and requirements of EDPC. And then a quality process management system with feedback control theory is proposed to ensure the training quality of students. Finally, the impacts of training on the students ' ability of solving complicated engineering problems are illustrated which enhance the students' learning outcomes and provide a reference of engineering education professional certification for relevant specialties.

articleTitle: 99mTc-MIBI Positive of Cervical Ectopic Thymoma Case Report and Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The thymus originates from the third and fourth pharyngeal sacs. The thymus migrates from the neck to the mediastinum during the embryonic period. Ectopic cervical thymoma (ECT) is an extremely rare type of neck tumor that occurs mainly due to the inability of the embryonic thymus to fall sufficiently. Our department had admitted a case of ECT patients. The patient found a tumor in the neck for 1 year. The tumor appeared progressively increased for 3 months. Neck ultrasound, CT and 99mTc-MIBI imaging before surgery failed to determine the origin of the tumor. Pathologically confirmed as type AB thymoma after surgery. It is reported as follows.

articleTitle: Classification of Abnormal Gait Based on Improved Two-Stream CNN
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Gait is a guidance of clinical diagnosis and an evaluation index for disease rehabilitation. Various diseases such as Parkinson's disease, hemiplegia and cerebellar ataxia can cause gait abnormalities. In this paper, we proposed an algorithm based on two-stream convolution neural network and attention mechanism. The algorithm can classify abnormal gait from input gait videos. Our proposed method achieved 86.28% accuracy in our gait data set.

articleTitle: Simulation of Traffic Rules Around Open Community Based on Cellular Automaton Model
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: According to certain mathematical rules, we establish a cellular automaton (CA) model for a traffic flow system with discrete dimensions, which considers the vehicle's driving on the road as a discrete dimension traffic flow system. We simulate the traffic of each two-lane road around the residential area with the STCA model, and simulate the traffic situation of the single-lane vehicles in the residential area with the NaSch model, and simulate the vehicle traffic at the intersection with the Cellular Automaton model. Taking the surrounding roads of three types of residential district as an example, we simulate the traffic situation before and after the opening of the residential district by VISSIM. Based on the data analysis of four kinds of road traffic impact index before and after the opening of three different types of residential areas, we obtain the influence of residential area opening on the peripheral road traffic.

Author Keywords: Community opening, traffic flow, Cellular automaton model, simulation

articleTitle: Differences of MARC Metadata in Digital Library for Mainland, Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macao
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Suggestions on Chinese literature cataloging of Mainland, Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macao are put forward, with a view to achieving world-wide sharing of Chinese bibliographic metadata. Cataloging rules and MARC format of Chinese literatures are compared in four places of China. The respective characteristics and the present situation are analyzed. According to the analysis results, CNMRAC, CMARC and MARC21 have their own advantages and disadvantages. A unified resource description framework is needed for the processing of Chinese literature cataloging. BIBFRAME is a more suitable unified resource description framework which needs further research and efforts to adapt to Chinese literatures in digital library.

Author Keywords: Metadata, Chinese literature, CNMARC, MARC21, Digital library

articleTitle: The Study of Functional Magnetic Resonance for Chronic Low Back Pain
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Object: Resting functional magnetic resonance imaging and ratio low-frequency amplitude methods were used to investigate the characteristics of brain functional changes in chronic low back pain. Method: Resting fMRI data were collected from 12 volunteers with chronic low back pain (4 males and 8 females, 47.9±6.1 years old) using a 3.0T magnetic resonance imager. Pretreatment and ALFF analysis were performed using DPARSF software, and single-sample t-test was performed in SPM8 to observe the changes of functional magnetic resonance in patients with chronic low back pain. Result: In patients with chronic low back pain, the resting ALFF values were significantly higher than the whole brain mean brain area, which mainly involved the anterior and posterior anterior gyrus, the median frontal gyrus, the medial frontal gyrus, the superior temporal gyrus, the lower marginal gyrus, and the back. Conclusion: Changes in brain function in patients with chronic low back pain were consistent with changes in cognition, mood, memory.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Practice Course Construction of Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) specialty belongs to the discipline of engineering application, requiring students to have strong practical and innovative abilities. Therefore, experimental teaching plays a very important role in the cultivation of innovative talents and quality education. However, the traditional experimental teaching system can not keep up with the development of the IoT discipline, and has shown many drawbacks. Therefore, it is urgent to conduct research on the IoT experimental teaching system and establish the IoT technology practical course to improve students' comprehensive practical ability.

articleTitle: Talking About the Application of Information Technology in College Aerobics Teaching
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In the new period, it is inseparable between China's development of information technology and human's production and life. It has been an efficacious way to develop that information and technology was integrated to the college aerobics teaching. Accordingly, facing the issues in aerobics teaching of normal universities, the use of information technology to implement the practical application of three stages includes pre-course, in-class and after-school from different perspectives of teachers and students. Only in this way can it be helpful for aerobics teaching. This measure in aerobics teaching could ultimately carry its point which promote the integrated development of students.

articleTitle: Flipped Classroom Teaching Practice of Compiler Principles Based on MOOC
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: To explore the blended teaching mode of MOOC (Massive Open Online Course) and flipped classroom for all-in-English teaching of compiler principles, the implementation scheme of flipped classroom is designed based on the MOOC of compiler principles. The details of classroom organization and the design of teaching content are proposed. Through the teaching practice of flipped classroom, it is shown that compared with traditional classroom, flipped classroom can mobilize the enthusiasm of learning and achieve better learning effect.

Author Keywords: Blended teaching, MOOC, Flipped classroom, Compiler principles

articleTitle: Research and Practice of "Internet + Teaching" Mode for Cyberkids
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Digital age, college students can easily get high-quality MOOC courses and other learning resources from the Internet. How to apply information technology in "Internet + teaching" is a serious problem what every college teacher faces. To solve this problem, we propose a mixed model, using the Internet and smart phones in the teaching process. Teachers and students can share same resources, co-build and win-win from it. This model promotes students' deep learning and realizes the deep integration of "teaching" and "learning". While improving the quality of teaching, it enhances students' learning ability.

articleTitle: Collaborative Learning of Hybrid Programming Based on Multi-platforms
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In view of the shortcomings of traditional Modern Logic Design experiments, the experimental design method based on multi-platforms is proposed. The cooperative teaching mode based on project are adopted, which guides the students to adopt modular design ideas to design a more complex digital system. The design of the modulation and demodulation system shows that the method combines the software simulation and the hardware experiment well, and improves the students' ability to solve the complex problems in the comprehensive application of the related theories. Correspondingly the students' ability to experiment independently are fostered, and the student achievements have been greatly improved.

articleTitle: Current Situation Analysis and Development Strategy Research on Educational Live Broadcasting Technology Based on SWOT Theory in Post-MOOC Era
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In the post-MOOC Era, with the rapid development of mobile Internet, live broadcast was more and more widely used in daily life. As a new online education mode, live broadcast plus education has exerted great influence on the current education mode. On the basis of sorting out the concept of educational live broadcasting and the current development situation of educational live broadcasting in China, this study analyzes the current situation of educational live broadcasting with SWOT theory, and proposes countermeasures based on the current educational reality, aiming to make educational live broadcasting better and more profoundly promote the development of education.

articleTitle: Research on Residents' Satisfaction with Family Physician Contacted Service in Xi'an Shan'an xi Province
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To analyze the residents' satisfaction with family doctors contracted services in Xi'an, and provide scientific basis for government departments to strengthen the construction of community health services, improve the quality of community health services and residents satisfaction. Method: Through consulting literatures, expert consultation and other methods to screen 12 service indexes, and the weighted rank sum ratio method was used to evaluate the satisfaction of family doctor's contracted service quality in different types of communities and family residents in Xi'an. Results: According to the survey of residents' satisfaction in Xi'an, it was found that the top three weighting factors in the evaluation index system are medical equipment (0.27), propaganda method (0.10) and home service (0.10). Using the weighted rank sum ratio method, we found that traditional old communities, community units, low-income families and empty-nest families are more satisfied with family doctor's contract service. However, comprehensive community and urban-rural community as well as high-income families, families with reorganization and chronic disease are less satisfied with family doctor's contract service. Conclusion: The medical equipment of community institutions, propaganda methods of family doctors contract service and the quality of home service are important factors which affecting the development of the business. In the family physician contract services process of actively implementing, Xi'an city should take advantage of strengthening the construction of the general practitioner team and improving the professional quality of medical staff and the utilization rate of medical equipment. Using the Internet plus to build a family physician contract service platform, strengthen the publicity and promotion of this service, strengthen the construction of community health service system and improve the convenience and normativeness of family doctors' contracted services.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Study for Autonomous Learning Ability Based on Factor Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Based on related theoretical frameworks and evaluation practices, the author formulates an evaluation questionnaire for autonomous learning ability, including self-orientation stage, application of learning strategies stage, self-monitoring stage, and self-evaluation stage. Then, through analyzing the principal components of questionnaire results, it constructs an evaluation model and scale for the autonomous learning ability of senior high school students which consists of four stages and nine factors. Data analysis shows that this scale features high reliability and validity. Therefore, this research provides useful references for the quantitative evaluation of senior high school students' autonomous learning ability.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Maker Education in Secondary Vocational Schools
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: At present, the traditional teaching methods are not enough to arouse interest of students in learning and it is difficult to achieve the expected learning effect in secondary vocational schools. In order to solve this problem, this paper has done some research in secondary vocational schools. It is found that Maker education, as a new form of secondary vocational education, has been loved by students to some extent. This paper makes a brief analysis of traditional teaching methods and creative education in terms of students' attitudes and achievements. It is found that students have good learning attitudes and high learning interest in Maker classroom, which is conducive to the systematic mastery of scientific knowledge. Moreover, this paper also conducts in-depth investigation and research on the feasibility and necessity of Maker Education in secondary vocational schools, which provides relevant theoretical basis for the full implementation of Maker education in secondary vocational schools.

articleTitle: High FAM83A Expression is a Novel Prognostic Indicator of Poor Overall Survival in Lung Adenocarcinoma
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Distinct subtypes of non-small-cell lung cancer (NSLSC) vary differently in sites of origin, histologies, genetic changes. To explore the potential prognostic value of family with sequence similarity 83A (FAM83A) in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) and lung squamous cell carcinoma (LUSC), we investigated the association of the expression of FAM83A and survival of NSLSC patients using CCLE, FireBrowse, UCSC Xena browser, cBioPortal, Kaplan-Meier Plotter and DAVID. We revealed that FAM83A expression was significantly higher in LUADs than in LUSCs. Increased FAM83A expression was associated with poor overall survival (OS) in LUAD, but not in LUSC. DNA amplification was associated with increased FAM83A expression, as well as significantly worse over survival and disease-free survival in LUAD. Among 22 genes co-expressed with FAM83A in LUAD and 95 genes co-expressed with FAM83A in LUSC, only 4 genes were present in the overlapping cluster. Some of the genes related biological processes and molecular functions in LUAD were not observed in LUSC. These results showed that FAM83A expression might serve as a prognostic indicator of unfavorable OS in LUAD.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Visual Assessment System for Biological Hazards Based on Baidu Maps
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In order to meet the needs of tackling emergencies caused by sudden biological threats, a visual assessment system is designed and implemented by applying the spatial analysis and mapping functions of Baidu Maps, the existing aerosol diffusion model and the population density data of provinces, cities and regions in China. By quickly assessing the scope of harm caused by aerosol release of pathogenic microorganisms and the number of people affected, and by carrying out visualized simulation and display on the map intuitively and dynamically, this system provides great support for the decision-making of medical service department to formulate effective emergency measures.

articleTitle: A Task-Oriented English Education Platform Powered by ICT&AI
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Lacking of pragmatic competence is a long existing issue for Chinese student, and the problem is even worse for those who live in rural regions, where both teachers and resource are rare. We are trying to break the regional disparity, provide better teaching resources for those in need by means of ICT and AI techniques that highly developed today. In this paper, we present the idea of how we designed and implemented this free English education platform to help kids especially those with financial difficulties to improve their pragmatic competence. In this platform, multiply access methods are provide at user side to adapt to different requirements; the unique server side is developed based on microservice architecture, which make the system easy to expand and maintain; a recommendation scheme and the social media system WeChat are employed as the main promotion methods; class is task-oriented designed to improve pragmatic competence of learner; online class, live video, and AI chatbot will be provided for different training purpose. This platform will integrate high-quality resource, and act as a hub that will connect eager learners and volunteer teachers, who can study and teach anywhere conveniently.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment Method for Host Nodes in Software Defined Networking
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Software Defined Networking (SDN) technology improves the flexibility and scalability of the network by separating the control plane from the data plane. However, because of its centralized control and other characteristics, the SDN controller has become the main target of attack and Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attack is one of the threats. Its large number of spoofed packets can take up the controller's resources, causing the controller to continuously process invalid traffic and run out of resources. Aiming at the DDoS attack in SDN, this paper proposes a risk assessment method for host nodes. First, we set up dangerous nodes in the topology, simulate the DDoS attack against them, and count the number of attacked events of each node. Then the risk coefficient of host nodes is calculated based on Beta distribution to make risk assessment. The experimental results show that our method can make a accurate risk assessment to the nodes, so that we can protect the high-risk nodes and improve the security of SDN.

articleTitle: Research on the Individualized and Differentiated Education Strategies of Left-Behind Children Based on the Five-Pattern Personality Test of Traditional Chinese Medicine
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The phenomenon of left-behind children is an objective phenomenon that has accompanied China's reform and opening up and rapid economic and social development, which has aroused widespread concern from the whole society. Most of the existing researches use left-behind children as a whole to conduct research and propose countermeasures, and most of them focus on the negative impact of left-behind experiences on left-behind children. The public also has a "stereotype" for left-behind children, and it is common that left-behind children are tagged and even viewed as problem children. However, this study shows that left-behind children can not be equated with problem children. Left-behind children with different TCM personality types also have different susceptibility to problem behaviors. Relatively speaking, Shaoyin type left-behind children tend to have more problem behaviors. The yin and yang balance-type left-behind children are less prone to problem behaviors. Therefore, the focus of education and care should be on avoiding the negative impact of the left-behind experience on the left-behind children of Shaoyin type. At the same time, we should not take left-behind children as a whole to put forward educational countermeasures, but adopt individualized and differentiated education strategies according to their different TCM personality types.

articleTitle: Study on the Influencing Factors of Quality of Life in Postoperative Patients with Breast Cancer
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: Aim to investigate the influencing factors of postoperative quality of life with breast cancer patients in Xi'an, and to provide scientific basis for promoting the health of breast cancer patients and improving their quality of life. Methods: we used the cluster sampling method to select 181 breast cancer patients in Xi'an as case study, and used the breast cancer quality of life scale (FACT-B and V4.0) to investigate the data. The status of quality of life, status of social family, emotional status, functional status, breast cancer attachment and other dimensions of quality of life were selected as the dependent variables, and the variables of general demographic characteristics and disease characteristics were taken as independent variables to make multiple linear regression analysis, and established the different dimension of the multiple linear model respectively. Results: the factors which influencing the postoperative quality of life of patients with breast cancer were pain, marital status, family per capita annual income, and whether complications. Among them, the more obvious the pain feeling, the marriage is divorced, widowed and other unstable state, the family per capita annual income is low, with complications and other characteristics of breast cancer patients, the lower of quality of life score. In addition, the source of medical expenses is an important factor which affecting the physiological state of the factors, the results show that the quality of life becomes worse. The patients with lower emotional scores were accompanied by anxiety, negative feeling of the disease, did not participate in anti-cancer association, less physical exercise; The patients who have lower educational level and late clinical stage had lower functional status scores. Conclusions: we should increase the health investment, improve the awareness of breast cancer patients, make early breast cancer screening for married women, eliminate the negative psychological emotions of breast cancer patients, and participate in physical exercise actively. Above all were the effective measures of improving the quality of life of breast cancer patients.

articleTitle: Improved K-Medoids Clustering Algorithm for a Class of P Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper presents an improved K-medoids clustering algorithm, which provides a new idea and method for clustering analysis[1]. The P membrane system has great parallielism[2]. This way can reduce the computing time and increase the computing efficiency, and is especially suitable for solving such problems like clustering. First, this paper proposes an improved algorithm based on the K-medoids algorithm[3]. This algorithm is based on the improved K-nearest algorithm. The initial point of the cluster is the K specific points that are selected in a specific way to reduce the number of operations, rather than from all non-central objects randomly selected in the original algorithm. Secondly, the paper P system has built all of the rules to solve the problem of K-medoids. The manner in which a particular P system is designed to calculate distances associated with n objects, such as a distance matrix or the like. The calculation of the system can lead to a possible classification in a non-deterministic way. Through multiple algorithm tests, the algorithm is suitable for cluster analysis and optimizes the K-medoids algorithm. This is a new attempt at membrane system applications.

articleTitle: MOOC Bandwidth Allocation Optimization Strategy
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper proposes a bandwidth allocation strategy based on differentiated bandwidth requirements for bandwidth allocation when multiple users access teaching resources on MOOC platform. This method improves the currently used bandwidth allocation strategy–the single-chain on-demand allocation strategy: considering the high lag of the small demand event under the original strategy, the bandwidth requirement of the small event is preferentially allocated to improve the allocation efficiency of the entire system. At the same time, the long waiting requests are optimized, and the weight of the event is appropriately increased to reduce the waiting time of such requests. The simulation results show that the optimization strategy proposed in this paper significantly improves the efficiency of small event resolution and reduces the waiting time of large requests. It reflects the efficiency and fairness of the distribution strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Effect of Domestic Dioscorea Pills on Body Immunity Over the Last Ten Years
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Yaosheng Zhang Zhongjing's Dioscorea Pill has been applied to skin diseases, respiratory diseases, immune systems, tumors and other diseases in clinic. In the past decade, the research on dioscorea pills has been widely conducted based on the development of modern Chinese medicine, and thus yield many significant outputs. For example, some research showed positive results regarding the application of yam pills in clinical pracices on diseases of many different systems, such as skin diseases, respiratory system, immune system and tumors. By contrast, others showed that dioscorea pills do not play a role in controlling disease progression and relieving symptoms when treating certain diseases.

Author Keywords: dioscorea pills, Immunity, Traditional Chinese medicine Introduction

articleTitle: Study on the Group Cohesion Force in Collaborative Knowledge Building Activity
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Group cohesion force is the attraction of the group to its members and the attraction among members of the collaborative group. It is very important for collaborative knowledge building activities. This paper analyzes the development of the group cohesive force in the collaborative knowledge building process with social measurement method. The results show that with the continuous implementing of collaborative knowledge building activities in blended learning environments, the post-test group cohesion force of all groups involved in collaborative knowledge building activities was significantly higher than the pre-test.

articleTitle: Charging and Discharging Optimization Management Model for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In order to deal with the increasingly serious resource and environmental problems, governments around the world are vigorously promoting electric vehicles. In this paper, we analyze the problem of charge and discharge optimization management of electric vehicle by SPSS. We solve the problem of disordered charging scheme of electric vehicle under large-scale operation, optimization of energy management of new energy charging station and optimization of charging and discharging behavior of electric vehicle in distribution network. And we carry out the large-scale simulation with the Monte Carlo simulation method. In this paper, we establish the optimization model with the Monte Carlo simulation method. In this model, the least investment is taken as the objective function and the peak and valley difference as the constraint conditions.

Author Keywords: Electric vehicle, charging and discharging, Monte Carlo method, optimize

articleTitle: Preliminary Study on Pre-Clinical Probation Program for Oral Medical Students Under the Guidance of the team of Supervisor Group in the new era
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In August 2018, the Ministry of Education announced: "Notice on the Implementation of the Spirit of the Undergraduate Education Work Conference of the National Higher Education in the New Era", which means that the era of strictest undergraduate teaching had arrived. Medical education is a subject that combines theory with practice, and has high requirements on practical teaching. The traditional oral medicine teaching mode is to concentrate on theoretical learning and then enter Clinical Practice stage directly. There are some questions under this mode. For example, theoretical teaching is boring. It's also hard for most students to understand clinical theory, let alone to seize their interests. Considering the current situation of domestic oral medicine education and the development requirements of key competences of oral medical students, the core of this paper is to propose some projects and try to solve the existing problems. Such as to make full use of the superior conditions of the tutor system, build reasonable tutorial group and guide stomatology undergraduates in the pre-clinical probation programs.

Author Keywords: Pre-clinical probation, Tutorial system, Key competences, Stomatology

articleTitle: Exploring Multi-loss Function Based Attention Framework for Vehicle Re-Identification
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Vehicle Re-identification(Re-ID) refers to the task of matching a specific vehicle across multiple non-overlapping cameras. Precise vehicle Re-ID suffers from two main challenges: (1) different vehicle identities with a similar appearance of the same type have a subtle inter-instance discrepancy, (2) one vehicle usually has large intra-instance differences due to viewpoint and illumination variations. To address these challenges, in this paper, we proposed an Attention-based Framework for Vehicle Re-ID named AFVR, which combines the benefits of both the cross-entropy loss function and the triplet loss function. Experimental results on two popular vehicle Re-ID benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method, compared with the state of the arts.

Author Keywords: Vehicle Re-ID, Attention Model, Re-identification, Convolutional Neural Network

articleTitle: Analysis of College Students' Mobile Phone Dependence and Influencing Factors
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: To investigate the mobile phone dependence and its influencing factors among college students in 3 universities in Shaanxi Province Methods: We selected total of 838 undergraduates in 3 colleges in Shaanxi province as the research objects. We used "the standard of mobile phone dependence syndrome to collect information and analyzed the factors which affecting college students' mobile phone dependence syndrome by Multi - factor logistics Regression. Results: It can be seen from this study that the rate of mobile phone dependent syndrome in college students is 27.2%. The male mobile phone dependence syndrome detection rate was significantly higher than that in female, enrollment for the city students, per capita income high students, mobile phone dependence syndrome detection rate is high; the history of art majors(OR=1.437), junior college students (OR=1.583) their mobile phone dependence syndrome detection rate are high. Students with frequent anxiety disorder (OR=2.192) and grief free (OR=1.976) have more pronounced symptoms of mobile phone dependence. Conclusion:, The 3 university students of Shaanxi Province mobile phone dependence syndrome detection rate is higher, the school should strengthen students' scientific use of mobile phone publicity and education, college students should strengthen self supervision and management, to avoid the long time use of mobile phone, mobile phone use to form a reasonable scientific attitude and habits, so as to improve college students' mental health and quality of life.

articleTitle: Application Method of Clinical Microbiology Testing Teaching Reform in the Age of "Internet +"
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Research Purpose: To explore the role of Internet platform in clinical microbiology laboratory practice teaching reform, so as to improve students' comprehensive quality and be competent for future clinical laboratory work. Proposed Methods: Students were randomly divided into two groups, control group and reform group. On the basis of traditional teaching methods, the reform group added the network-based hybrid teaching method, while the control group adopted the traditional teaching method. The theoretical and clinical skills of the two groups were compared. Results: The score of clinical microbiological examination skill and theoretical examination in the reform group were higher than those in the control group, and the difference was statistically significant. Conclusion: In the era of "Internet +", integrating network based blended teaching mode into clinical microbiology examination teaching practice is not only conducive to students to expand and enrich their theoretical knowledge, but also greatly improve their clinical practice skills, laying a good foundation for their smooth work in the future.

articleTitle: Progress in Diagnosis and Treatment of Parathyroid Carcinoma (a Literature Review)
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In 1904, De Quervain first reported non-functional parathyroid carcinoma (PC). In 1938, Amstrong first reported hypercalcemia of parathyroid carcinoma. PC is a rare and easily recurring endocrine malignancy. To date, more than 1000 cases of parathyroid carcinoma have been reported in the English literature[1, 2, 3, 4], and more than 200 cases have been reported in Chinese literature[5, 6]. Unlike parathyroid adenomas, the incidence of parathyroid cancer is similar in men and women [1,3,4,5,7], and the age of onset of parathyroid carcinoma in the English literature is 57 years [1,2], The Chinese literature is 45.5 years old [5]. Todd et al. found that the incidence of parathyroid cancer in the United States increased by 60% from 1988 to 2003[7], and our study[5] found that the literature on parathyroid cancer in China has also increased year by year; Preoperative diagnosis of parathyroid carcinoma is difficult, and the rate of frozen pathological diagnosis is low, which is often difficult to distinguish from parathyroid adenoma; The recurrence rate of PC was high, and there were cases of 5 times of surgery after recurrence of parathyroid carcinoma[8]; The efficacy of traditional radiotherapy and chemotherapy on PC is not yet clear. Therefore, preoperative and intraoperative identification of suspicious malignant cases, active radical resection of the lesions and comprehensive medical treatment have important implications for the prognosis of patients.

articleTitle: The Relationship Between Subjective Well-Being and Academic Achievement of Primary and Middle School Students
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The aim of this study is to explore the basic situation of subjective well-being among primary and secondary school students and the relationship between academic achievement and subjective well-being. A questionnaire survey using the "Adolescent Student Life Satisfaction Scale" and the "Happy Feeling Scale" was conducted on 800 students from 6 high schools in Shanxi Province. The results of the study: (1) The subjective well-being of primary and secondary school students are at the upper-middle level. (2) The subjective well-being of female is generally higher than that of male, and the life satisfaction of primary school students is gender-specific. (3) There are grade differences in life satisfaction and positive emotions between primary school students and junior high school students. (4) The academic performance of primary school students and junior high school students was significantly positively correlated with life satisfaction, and negatively correlated with negative emotions. Research conclusions: Subjective well-being has a great influence on the academic performance of primary school students and junior high school students, and enhancing their subjective well-being is conducive to improving their academic performance.

articleTitle: On Transformation of Educational Management at the Time of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: One of the major questions of educational management is the need of advanced and professional tools and technology for educational management. It is critical for the improvement and enhance of educational management to utilize state-of-the-art information technology, building a platform for highly efficient and professional educational management. First of all, theoretical conception of Instrumental Reason should be clarified, so that basic properties of big-data as well as their deep impact on educational management could be explored. Based on this, a model of management with educational big-data is being prototype, concentrating on the four basic elements-subjective, objective, resource, target. Further on, the road-map is drawn to explain its implementation in accordance with big-data characteristics. The author suggests, in conclusion, that educational management should be wholly transformed and renewed with data processing technology and big-data orientation, so as to realize a success to promote new theory, new technology and new culture of educational management.

Author Keywords: Big Data, Educational Management, Instrumental Reason, Model Transformation

articleTitle: Research on the Current Situation of the Curriculum Design of Internet of Things Specialty in China
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: By comparing the curriculum design and training objectives of the Internet of things major in some colleges and universities in China, this paper can understand the current situation of the Internet of things specialty in China, and provide a certain scientific basis for the curriculum design of the Internet of things specialty. This paper compares the computer science and technology, the communication engineering, the training plan of the Internet of things technology, the requirements of graduation and so on in some colleges and universities in China, and provides some theoretical basis for how to train the talents in the field of the Internet of things. At the same time also for the Internet of things professional curriculum design to provide some support.

articleTitle: A Training System of Graduate Internationalization Based on CDIO
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: A training system of graduate internationalization based on CDIO is designed to construct a systematic, reasonable, standardized and effective teaching structure with a view of internationalization. Based on the status analysis of the internationalization cultivation, CDIO is studied to realize the life cycle of products from research & design to operation and applied to construct an integrated cultivation system for internationalization education. Results of the surveys and statistics show that the combination of internationalized awareness, knowledge and researching ability with CDIO supplies an effective way to cultivate graduates with high-level internationalized talents including innovative thinking and practical ability.

articleTitle: Research on College Teachers Teaching Ability Evaluation Model Based on DHNN
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The teaching ability of teachers is one of the core abilities of colleges. Its level has gradually become an important indicator for evaluating a school. However, the existing evaluation models of college teachers are timeconsuming, empirical, complex, subjective and speculative. Therefore, based on the teaching features of colleges in China, this paper constructs a fast and effective college teacher evaluation model by discrete Hopfield neural network technology, and introduces the basic ideas and steps of the model.

articleTitle: The "top N Groups" Method used to mine the Empirical Formula Based on Apriori Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Based on Apriori algorithm, establish a method for mining the medical empirical formula. Procedures and Methods: input the 1,632 medical records of Chen Shouqiang, Associate Chief Physician, into the electronic medical records management system; mine the high-frequency combination of traditional Chinese medicine for treatment of coronary heart disease via the Apriori algorithm; take the combination with most kinds of herbal medicines as the motherboard, and then add Chinese medicine different from what included in the top N groups of high-frequency combinations of traditional Chinese medicine; thus we can sum up the empirical formula. Results: the empirical formula mined consists of 12 herbs (i.e. rhizome of Ligusticum wallichii, salvia miltiorrhiza, tuber of dwarf lilyturf, Costustoot, licorice Roots Northwest Origin, Schisandra chinensis, Coptis chinensis, Scutellaria baicalensis, charred triplet, fructus forsythiae, cuttlebone and radix astragali), which is similar with the chest stuffiness No. 2 formula commonly used in clinic. Conclusion: This method has some significance in the experience heritage of distinguished veteran doctors of TCM, and it is worth promoting.

articleTitle: Automatic Conversion of Electronic Medical Record Text for OpenEHR Based on Semantic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The OpenEHR specification standard utilizes the two-layer modeling principle which is in line with the electronic medical record specification to ensure the high scalability of the electronic medical record model and the high applicability of the medical field knowledge, and to solve the problem of poor accessibility and low availability. In order to realize the automatic conversion of any format-text electronic medical records to OpenEHR, this paper proposes a wide & deep network to match the electronic records of free texts with OpenEHR templates, and proposes a labeling model which use conditional random fields and cyclic neural networks for the extraction of clinical test items.

articleTitle: Anti-Synthetase Syndrome with Interstitial Pneumonia as the First Manifestation
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Idiopathic inflammatory myopathies (IIM) are a group of refractory heterogeneous autoimmune diseases with polymyositis (PM) and skeletal myositis infiltration with multiple organ involvement. Derm-atomyositis (DM) is a common clinical subtype of IIM. IIM autoantibodies include myositis specific au-toant-ibodies (MSAs) and myositis associated autoantibodies (MAAs). Recent studies have found anti-synthetase antibody profiles (including anti-Jo-1, anti-PL-7 and anti-PL-12 antibodies), anti-Mi-2 antibodies, signal recognition particle (SRP) antibodies, and anti-synthesis hydroxy-3-methyl-glutaryl-coa reductase (H-MGCR) antibody, melanoma differentiation associa-ted gene 5 (MDA5) antibody, nuclear matrix protein 2 (NXP2) antibodies and transcriptional intermediation factor 1γ (TIF1γ) antibodies are strongly associated with IMM or clinical features of different clinical subtypes, early diagnosis of IIM, suggesting organ involvement and prognosis Aspects are of paramount importance. This article is to understand the clinical features of anti-synthetase syndrome by studying a patient with JO-positive of dermatomyositis.

articleTitle: Study on Intervention of Depression Patients Based on TCM Health Management Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: Based on TCM health management platform, this paper explores the effect of TCM intervention on the psychological state and quality of life of patients with depression. Methods: 50 patients with depression were randomly divided into two groups. The control group was treated with paroxetine hydrochloric acid. On this basis, the experimental group was treated with TCM intervention based on the health management system of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM). The scores of SAS, SDS, and WHOQOL-BREF were observed before and after treatment. Results:After treatment, the SAS, SDS score and WHOQOL-BREF score of the two groups were significantly different (P <; 0.05). Conclusion: Based on The health management platform of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) can reduce the score of SAS and SDS, improve the survival treatment of patients and effectively control the condition of depression patients.

articleTitle: Quality Evaluation System of Full-Time Professional Degree Graduate Education
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: A quality evaluation system of full-time profession degree graduate education is proposed on the basis of CDIO (Conceive, Design, Implementing & Operate) engineering education and control theory in the paper. With the characteristic analysis of full-time profession degree graduate education, the cultivating core process of full-time profession degree graduate education is deduced to provide theoretical support for the training structure of full-time profession degree graduate education based on CDIO.

articleTitle: Research on Education Resource Recommendation Algorithm Based on Implicit Feedback and Pairwise
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In view of the problem of how to improve the accuracy of education resources recommendation in Internet era, a recommendation algorithm based on implicit feedback and pairwise education resources are proposed. Firstly, the feature extraction of learner-education resource is carried out, and the implicit features of learner-education resource are extracted by implicit semantic model, and the prediction results of factor decomposition are used as input to sorting learning algorithm. Converting sorting problems to classification problems uses the theory of ordering learning. Based on the experiment comparison with the traditional recommendation algorithm, it is compared with the comparison algorithm, which has better effect on the recommendation of educational resources. The algorithm increases by nearly 30% on metrics MAP, NDGG.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Universal Data Quality Management Software Based on Data Flow
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Data quality problems are analyzed to get several typical problems, such as data missing, data duplication, data abnormality, data inconsistency and data logic error. In order to resolve these problems, a universal data quality management software is proposed. This software provides data cleaning method for each problem and evaluates the effect of these methods, and manages the plug-in components for use. The architecture and critical technologies are introduced in detail, and main steps are shown with a specific application. According to the feedback of users, this new software is powerful, adaptable, simple to use, easy to set processes, with high data cleaning efficiency and accurate effect evaluations.

articleTitle: The Research of a Memory Accesses Behavior on Non-Uniform Memory Access Architecture
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Choosing a good threads and data distribution scheme to the performance of data-parallel applications is important on Non-Uniform Memory Access (NUMA) architecture workstation. In this paper, we delve into the characterization of an NUMA multiprocessor system, design experiments to compare the differences of two types memory behavior with the memory bandwidth load and without the memory bandwidth load. We analyzed the performance of the two cases and have the important conclusion about the threads accessing to the memory.

articleTitle: Study on the Initial Values of the Latent Ability Distribution When Estimating the IRM Parameters Using EM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Using the EM algorithm can estimate the item parameters and the latent ability distribution parameters in the item response models at the same time. However, the initial values for the latent ability distribution parameters have a noteworthy impact on the parameters estimation results. In this paper, a method of adjusting initial values for the latent ability distribution based on mean and variance is presented. It can reduce the influence of initial values on estimation results so as to make the estimation results within a reasonable range and promote the practical application of the estimation of latent ability distribution. The feasibility of this adjustment method is illustrated by comparing with the marginal maximum likelihood Bock-Aitken algorithm.

articleTitle: Scoring Mechanism of Defect Report Based on Text Similarity
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the rapid development of the software industry in recent years, the demand for software testing talents in the society is also growing. Therefore, more and more colleges and universities set up "software testing technology" courses in related majors. Finding defects is a basic skill of software testing technology training. Some defects are difficult to find and some defects are easy to find. How to give reasonable evaluation according to the difficulty and quantity of defects in the defect report submitted by students often requires much of teacher's time and effort. This paper proposes a defect repetitive detection method based on the combination of TF-IDF and cosine similarity and proposes a defect report scoring mechanism based on the difficulty level and number of defects found by students. Comparing the manually scores of the defect reports by the teachers, the scoring mechanism is reasonable and effective, and greatly improves the work efficiency of the teachers.

articleTitle: Imaging and Clinical Features of Intrahepatic Biliary Cystadenocarcinoma
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To investigate the computed tomography (CT), magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and clinical features of intrahepatic biliary cystadenocarcinoma. Methods: The imaging and clinical data of two patients with intrahepatic biliary cystadenocarcinoma confirmed by pathology were retrospectively analyzed. CT and MRI examinations were performed in all patients. Results: The main complaint was upper abdominal discomfort. The lesion grows actively, which usually gets bigger in a short time. The lesion showed a solitary mass in the liver, with irregular shapes and clear boundaries. The lesion was mainly cystic, usually with solid nodules. MRI showed that the cystic part showed low signal on T1WI, high signal on T2WI, high signal on DWIBS, and without enhancement. The solid part shows a slightly higher signal, and the dispersion is slightly limited, and the enhancement can be seen. Conclusion: The combination of imaging and clinical features is helpful for the diagnosis of intrahepatic biliary cystadenocarcinoma.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Personalized Teaching System for Online Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the development and popularization of the Internet and multimedia technology, online learning has become a trend in education. Based on the analysis of the current situation of personalized teaching in present education platforms, we found that online learning, as an independent learning method, has some disadvantages. For example, with insufficient learning environment provided, learning enthusiasm is poor and some students would not participate in courses actively. In this paper, we design and implement a personalized teaching system for online learning, which is suitable for blended learning. In online learning, personalized courses are recommended according to each student's interests and needs. Moreover, discussion areas are set up for communication among teachers and students. In the personalized teaching system, the students' learning status and activity levels are recorded, along with the questions raised in the discussion area. Finally, the system is applied in the course of python programming and the experimental results show that the personalized teaching is achieved and diversified assessment can be realized.

articleTitle: Information System of Undergraduate Training Program for Engineering Education Accreditation
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The information system of undergraduate training program can reduce the tedious labor, and has great significance for implementing the engineering education professional accreditation.
