Based on the polychromatic sets theory, the information model of undergraduate training program was constructed and described formally from horizontal and vertical directions. The reasoning algorithm of information model was proposed and the related knowledge of undergraduate training program was reasoned automatically in logic layer. The proposed information modelling and knowledge reasoning method of undergraduate training program has some obvious advantages for supporting engineering education accreditation.

articleTitle: Clinical Effect Observation of New Transvaginal Pelvic Organ Prolapse Operation
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Purpose: To analyze the clinical effect of new transvaginal pelvic organ prolapse surgery. Method: 100 cases of pelvic organ prolapse accepted by our hospital from July 2017 to July 2018 were selected as subjects and randomly divided into control group and treatment group. Conventional operation and new transvaginal pelvic organ prolapse were performed for treatment respectively, and the results were analyzed after treatment. [Results]: The treatment of the two groups was compared. The operation time and intraoperative blood loss in the treatment group were less than those in the control group. Patients were followed up for 2 months after surgery. The recurrence rate was 4% in the treatment group, 12% in the control group, and low in the treatment group. Conclusion: In the case of pelvic organ prolapse, the new transvaginal pelvic organ prolapse operation is economical and feasible in primary hospitals, which is worth popularizing.

articleTitle: Effects of Hypoglycemic Anti-Deafness Prescription on Insulin Resistance in Patients with Diabetes Mellitus and Deafness
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective to investigate the effect of hypoglycemic anti - deafness prescription on insulin resistance in patients with diabetes mellitus and deafness. Methods: the fasting blood glucose (FPG), fasting insulin (FINS) and insulin sensitive index (IAI) were measured in42 cases (84 ears) with diabetes mellitus with different syndromes and deafness before and after treatment with hypoglycemic anti-deafness prescription. The control group was 40 normal subjects. Results compared with normal people, patients with different syndromes had different degrees of insulin resistance before treatment, and showed abnormal FPG, FINS and IAI (P<; 0.05). IAI index: Yin deficiency with heat and heat, qi and Yin deficiency with heat and heat, Yin and Yang deficiency with heat and heat, Yin and Yang deficiency with heat- and heat, Yin and Yang deficiency with heat and heat. Conclusion: hypoglycemic anti-deafness prescription can improve insulin resistance in patients with diabetes mellitus.

Author Keywords: hypoglycemic anti-deafness prescription diabetes deafness insulin resistance

articleTitle: Genarate and Solve Sudoku Puzzle
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In our paper, we set four levels of difficulty for Sudoku puzzles: Easy, Mild, Hard, Very hard. And we add points to every level, which the number of points is due to algorithms of varying difficulty. Such as generating a full puzzle, removing some of the cells, solving the puzzle and Single-Solution are discussed, at last, we give a mathematical model to ensure unique solution.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Hybrid Teaching Model in Biological Separation and Purification Technology Under the Background of "Internet +"
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Hybrid teaching mode is one of the effective teaching methods at present. The arrival of "Internet +" era provides a new way for the development and implementation of hybrid teaching mode. This paper discusses the hybrid teaching mode of biological separation and purification technology under the background of "Internet +", and elaborates from the aspects of "pre-class, in-class, after-class and evaluation", so as to provide direct experience for the promotion of mixed teaching mode under the background of "Internet +".

Author Keywords: Internet+, Hybrid teaching mode, Biological separation and purification technology

articleTitle: The Monocular Stereoscopic Model Based on an Ordered Wave Particle Swarm
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Visual neuroscience data support monocular depth cues such as texture gradients. Although the binocular disparity energy model has been developed, it concentrates on binocular depth perception. We present a monocular stereoscopic model based on an ordered wave particle swarm to explain monocular cues to depth. The ordering of the particle swarm is triggered by the stereoscopic potential embedded in textures to create monocular depth perception. First, each receptive field (RF) as a wave particle was expressed as a wave equation, and a stereoscopic potential field was extracted from monocular depth cues as the initial conditions. Second, the solutions of wave equations showed that the wave particles affected by the potential field were ordered by frequency. Finally, the consistency of the monocular model with the Gabor filter was discussed.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation of Long-Life Products Based on Performance Degradation Data
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Traditional reliability evaluation was based on the product's failure time. However, as product quality increases, it was difficult to collect sufficient failure data for a limited test time. With few failures or even zero failures of high-reliability and long-life products, the traditional life reliability evaluation could not meet the actual needs. Therefore, a reliability evaluation method based on performance degradation data was proposed. On the basis of the collected performance degradation data of long-life products, we developed a performance degradation model and a life distribution model. Furthermore, the parameter estimation method, model checking method, and model optimization method of the models are proposed to realize the reliability evaluation of long-life products. Finally, a certain type of quartz flexible accelerometer was taken as an example to evaluate its reliability. The mean time to failure of this type of quartz flexible accelerometer was 12.12 years, which verified the practicability of the method.

articleTitle: Dedicated Transformer Stealing Identification System Based on Big Data Analysis Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the rapid development of China's economy, the electricity users and the electricity demand have shown a rapid growth trend, while the power stealing behavior, especially the special transformer user's power stealing behavior is increasingly serious. The traditional anti-theft model is too simple, subjective, and has low recognition accuracy. To this end, based on the research on the tampering method of the special user, we designed the feature vector for the tampering method, and adopted the vector similarity matching method to accurately measure the characteristics of the electricity users of the special users and clarify the suspects of tampering. And in the field application of the State Grid Zhejiang company, has achieved good results, with strong practicality and promotion value.

articleTitle: Automatic Evaluation Method Using Dependency Parsing Model Based on Maximum Entropy
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The automatic evaluation of machine translation has achieved rich results. Various evaluation methods have emerged. This paper mainly introduces the automatic evaluation method using dependency parsing model based on maximum entropy. The dependency tree reflects the relationship between words in the sentence. Therefore, we use the dependency tree corresponding to the reference and the dependency tree corresponding to the machine translation to judge the accuracy of machine translation. In our method, the dependency tree of the reference is used as the training corpus to obtain the dependency parsing model. The model is used to generate the score of the machine translation dependency tree. Maximum entropy method is used in the dependency parsing process. The experimental results show that, at the system level, the new metric based on maximum entropy dependency parsing model is effective.

articleTitle: Research on the Hierarchical and E-Learning Teaching for Composition Principle of Computer Course
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper researched the hierarchical teaching mode and E-learning teaching methods of Composition Principle of Computer course. According to the specific situation of the students, they were divided into four levels. Then, the teaching tasks were implemented by the principle of teaching methods according to their aptitude, so that the hierarchical concept ran through the whole process of this course teach ranging from class, assignment, after-class guidance to others. In order to improve the teaching effect this paper also studied and constructed multi-media teaching means, which were integrated with case teaching, analogy teaching, heuristic teaching and contrast teaching. Based on this, the E-learning educational technology with "cooperative" learning as the core idea was introduced, which advocated the learning and exploration through communication and cooperation, so as to improve the students' learning initiative and exercise their learning ability.

articleTitle: Application of Digital Mining Technology in the Treatment of Depressive Symptoms in Patients with Post-Stroke Depression
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To explore the effect of psychotherapy on reducing the depressive degree and improving the daily living ability of post-stroke depression patients. Methods: Sixty patients with post-stroke depression were hospitalized in the Rehabilitation Department of Jiangxi Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital from October 2018 to April 2019. In this study, patients were randomly divided into observation group and control group by random number table, so there were 30 patients in each group. The patients in the control group received routine rehabilitation treatment, while the patients in the observation group received psychological treatment once a week in addition to the routine treatment of the control group. The changes of scores of Hamilton Depression Scale (HAMD) and Activity of Daily Living Scale (ADL) before and after psychotherapy were compared between the two groups. Results: After 2 months, the scores of HAMD and ADL in the observation group and the control group were lower than those before psychological treatment. The scores of HAMD and ADL in the observation group were significantly lower than those in the control group after psychological treatment. The difference was statistically significant (t=-17.41, p<; 0.00; t=-5.89, p<; 0.00). This shows that the degree of depression of the patient has decreased and the ability of daily living has increased after psychotherapy. Conclusion: Psychotherapy can reduce the degree of depression and improve the ability of daily living in patients with post-stroke depression.

articleTitle: Auxiliary Diagnostic Model of Atrial Fibrillation Based on Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Atrial Fibrillation(AF) is one of the main causes of multiple cardiovascular disease's birth and death, which has prompted researchers to study more accurate predictive models to assist doctors in screening patients with AF. In this paper, the RCDT (Random-Cost-Decision Tree) algorithm is presented, and it is applied to the data mining of AF, which construct an assistant diagnostic model of atrial fibrillation. Compared with the scores of the four types of high-risk groups for the prediction of AF, the model proposed in this paper had the best performance, with the accuracy rate reaching 88.76%, the sensitivity reaching 95.5%, and the area under the ROC curve reaching 92.77%.

Author Keywords: Atrial Fibrillation, auxiliary diagnosis, RCDT algorithm

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Novel R-Peak Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: As a crucial part of electrocardiogram (ECG) signal processing, the R-peak detection algorithm is important for the calculation and analysis of cardiac-specific parameters in heart health monitoring and heart disease diagnosis. To achieve high-quality R-peak detection, this paper proposes a novel algorithm consisting of four parts. The digital filtering is used to remove noise interference. The Shannon energy envelope is adopted to achieve QRS complexes enhancement and noise reduction simultaneously. The curve length transformation based on window division is used to suppress pseudo R-peaks. The Hilbert transform achieves no threshold settings and no prior knowledge of detected R-peaks. The algorithm is evaluated by using the MIT-BIH arrhythmia database and achieves average detection accuracy of 99.86%, precision of 99.97%, recall of 99.89%.

articleTitle: Optimization Method of Equipment Spare Parts Based on Monte Carlo Simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Combined with the engineering requirements of the current equipment spare parts optimization, an optimization method of equipment spare parts based on Monte Carlo simulations is proposed. The spare parts support model of the equipment was constructed using a Monte Carlo simulation analysis, and the operational availability and the spare parts support costs of the equipment were obtained. Then, the fuzzy multi-objective optimization method was used to comprehensively evaluate the operational availability and the spare parts support costs of the equipment, and the optimal initial spare parts list that met the decision-makers' satisfaction was obtained. Finally, the case application was carried out with the spare parts optimization of a certain type of equipment. The results showed that the proposed method could effectively solve the problem of spare parts optimization of equipment.

articleTitle: Tissue-Like P System with Mutational Symport/Antiport Rules and Trigger Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In order to describe and study the communication between the cells or between cells and environment, tissue P system with symport/antiport rules and tissue-like P system with evolutional symport/antiport rules was introduced as a class of distributed parallel computing model, the object can change their location or evolve in the communication process. But the objects and evolutional rules are not specific, so in this paper, a new computing model for P system called tissue-like P system with mutational symport/antiport rules and trigger mechanism (TPMTM) is proposed, where all genetic materials are encoded by binary strings and the evolutional rules are defined by mutational rules. The TPMTM' s computational power is testified. Extraordinary, tissue-like P system with one cell what executing mutational antiport rules of length of mutational position at most 5 or executing mutational symport rules of length of mutational position at most 7 are testified Turing universal. So, this tissue P system with mutational communication rules that we proposed is computable.

articleTitle: Research on Logistics Site-Selection Algorithms Based on EXCEL Computing Model
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The location and planning of the distribution center is the key to determining the quality of the entire logistics system. The proper location of the distribution center is critical to the entire logistics system. The center of gravity method is a common location model in the location of distribution centers. The calculation formula of the center. of gravity method is complicated, and the use of manual is not only complicated, time -consuming, but also error-prone. In this paper, for the shortcomings of manual calculation, an excel calculation model is established instead of manual calculation. The research proves that the excel calculation model not only improves the efficiency of the centroid calculation, but also improves the accuracy, and can also calculate the multiple different siting problems.

articleTitle: Measurement and Modelling of Burst Impulse Noise in Power Line Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In this paper, burst impulse noise is measured and a practical burst impulse noise model is proposed. The noise presented on power-line system is generated by start or stop of relay and motor. The parameters of noise model were derived from measurements of the mains voltages by using data acquisition card and a digital signal processing program. Using the measured parameters, the burst impulse noise model is established. The simulation shows that the results of proposed model are very akin to actual power line noise, it helps researcher to work independent of power line voltage in complex working environment.

articleTitle: Study on Knowledge Map of Ancient Prescription Books of TCM
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: By analyzing the digitization of ancient books or ancient prescription books in China, this paper summarizes the problems faced by the utilization of these books. In the context of the information age, except for the selection and collation of ancient books, the main problems of TCM ancient books mainly focus on how to effectively use them. Different scholars put forward corresponding solutions. On this basis, we attempts to index some ancient books. Based on the relationship entities that were obtained, it extracts the relationship of ancient prescription books. The knowledge map is constructed by the relationships obtained, so these ancient books of traditional Chinese medicine play a guiding role in medical work of modern society.

Author Keywords: prescription books, manual indexing, knowledge map

articleTitle: Teaching Reform of Virtual Simulation Training in Parodontology
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the popularization and development of computer technology, the use of intelligent methods in oral training teaching has greatly promoted the evaluation of oral training results and the mastery of preclinical operation, thus promoting the continuous progress and development of stomatology. At present, the virtual simulation technology is more mature in the field of oral training and teaching: the digital oral anatomy three-dimensional reconstruction technique, the Mug digital virtual oral skills training system, the oral medicine robot training machine and the like. The application of these computer technologies has improved the traditional oral experimental teaching and brought new ideas to the reform of oral experimental teaching. By introducing virtual technology into the experimental teaching of Parodontology, a simulation training method of visual and tactile fusion is provided for medical students. Through the operation on the virtual model, the students realized the threedimensional cognition of periodontal system anatomy and the control of the power of Supragingival scalingt, which laid a solid foundation for clinical practice.

articleTitle: Research on Teaching Evaluation Model Based on Weighted Naive Bayes
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the index weight distribution of teaching evaluation system is not objective, and the evaluation method cannot feedback the evaluation result in time, a method of constructing a teaching evaluation model based on weighted naive bayes algorithm is proposed. Firstly, a large amount of actual data of students' teaching evaluation was collected and sorted out, and data mining technology was adopted to realize data preprocessing of evaluation data. Secondly, the evaluation value was mapped into different grades, and a classifier based on weighted naive bayes algorithm was established. Finally, the classifier was used to assign different weights to each evaluation index, and the teaching evaluation results could be given in time through the classifier. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional teaching evaluation method, the evaluation model has better classification performance and the classification accuracy can reach 0.75. Therefore, this method can provide a reasonable scientific technical reference for teaching evaluation.

articleTitle: Building Smart Classroom of Combinatorial Mathematics Based on PBL Teaching Model
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the prevalence of artificial intelligence and the continuous development of information-based teaching, the emergence of smart classrooms has provided a new teaching environment for classroom teaching. As a new and efficient teaching mode, smart classroom has entered schools. Based on the classical PBL teaching method, this paper attempts to construct the question-driven smart classroom of combinatorial mathematics, and shares some teaching experience and experience from the aspects of teaching preparation, teaching implementation and teaching evaluation.

articleTitle: Study of "Water of Life" on Repair of Human Umbilical Cord Mesenchymal Stem Cells
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: H-MSC cell is a human pluripotent tissue cell. Through real-time dynamic observation of "water of life" prepared through "coded impulse treatment technology" in H-MSC cell growth and proliferation, apoptosis and drug killing experiments, it finds that the H-MSC cells cultured through the "water of life" culturing system have significant difference from the control group in terms of cell viability, cell repair ability and cell mortality (P<; 0.001, n=8). This technique uses the digital orbital principle of the "digital formula of bending relativity". The orbit in the water conforms to the frequency of cells and the quantum entanglement theory is also demonstrated, so that "water of life" can protect and maintain the growth process of H-MSC cells, which proves that water quality determines the fate of cells.

Author Keywords: coded impulse, water of life, positive drug, digital orbit,

articleTitle: Analysis of Causes and Treatment Strategies for False Positive and False Negative of 99mTc-MIBI SPECT: Experience Sharing and Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: For patients with suspected parathyroid gland tumors, 99mTc-MIBI SPECT dual-phase imaging of parathyroid glands was performed to analyze the results of false positives and false negatives, to explore treatment strategies and to summarize treatment experience. Method: We Analysed the false positive and false negative results of 99mTc-MIBI SPECT in 55 patients with suspected parathyroid glands treated by the author's medical team from January 2013 to April 2019. Combining preoperative examination results, intraoperative conditions and postoperative pathological data, we summarized the causes of false positive and false negative results, explored treatment strategies, and summarized treatment experience. Result:There were 11 cases of false positive and false negative result of 99mTc-MIBI SPECT. There were 4 cases of 99mTc-MIBI SPECT false positive in patients with non-primary parathyroidism, including 2 cases of nodular goite, 1 case of thyroid adenoma and 1 case of cervical ectopic thymoma; There were 5 cases of primary hyperpara-thyroidism patients with 99mTc-MIBI SPECT false negative, respectively, 1 case of parathyroid carcinoma, 1 case of parathyroid cyst, 1 case of smalle parathyroid adenoma, 1 case of cystic changes of parathyroid adenoma, 1 case of atypical parathyroid adenoma; There were 2 cases of primary hyperp-arathyroidism patient, 99mTc-MIBI SPECT results changed from negative to positive. One case 99mTc-MIBI SPECT result changed from negative to positive after 12 months interval, and her PTH increased from 310.5pg/ml to 887.4pg/ml. An ectopic parathyroid adenoma was found in her upper mediastinum and resected. The other case 99mTc-MIBI SPECT result changed from negative to positive after 42 months interval, PTH increased from 161pg/ml to 350pg/ml, and finally ectopic parathyroid glands were found in the posterior right sternosacral joint (zone VII) and surgically removed. Conclusion: Masses located on the dorsal side of the thyroid often need to be differentiated from parathyroid tumors. However, primary hyperparathyroidism first requires a qualitative diagnosis whether they was primary hyperparathy-roidism. If the qualitative diagnosis was negative, we need to consider whether it was a false positive caused by other diseases when the 99mTc-MIBI SPECT localization diagnosis was positive. If the qualitative diagnosis was positive, but the 99mTc-MIBI SPECT localization diagnosis was negative, and it was necessary to combine other examinations to assist in the localization of parathyroid tumors. 99mTc-MIBI SPECT can be changed from negative to positive in some patients with positive qualitative diagnosis and negative 99mTc-MIBI SPECT localization diagnosis.

Author Keywords: 99mTc-MIBI, False Positive, False Negative, Parathyroid Adenoma, Parathyroid Carcinoma

articleTitle: Research on Correlation Between Serum IGF-1, TNF-a and Atherosclerosis in Patients with Diabetes
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To observe between serum levels of IGF-1, TNF-a and carotid atherosclerosis plaque in patients with diabetes. Methods: 233 patients were measured with their bilateral carotid intima media thickness(IMT) by ultrasound. According to the result of ultrasound examination, patients were divided into case group(n=120) and control group(n=113) serum IGF-1, TNF-a levels of patients were measured by Immunoradiometric assay. Result: IGF-1 levels were obvious lower in plaque group than group of the normal subjects and have a statistical meaning(P<; 0.01), IGF-1 levels were negative correlation with the degree of carotid atherosclerosis plaque(P<; 0.01). TNF-a levels were higher in case group than in control group and have a statistical meaning(P<; 0.01), IGF-1 levels were positive correlation with the degree of carotid atherosclerosis plaque(P<; 0.01). Conclusion: IGF-1 and TNF-a may be involved in the occurrence and development of macroangiopathy in atherosclerotic patients with diabetes, and has closely related to the degree of carotid atherosclerosis plaque.

Author Keywords: IGF-1, TNF-a, DM, Carotid atherosclerosis plaque

articleTitle: Cognition of Food Toxicology Course in a Traditional Chinese Medicine University
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: To understand the cognition of the Food Toxicology course in the Food Hygiene and Nutrition major in a traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) University, and to provide references for the better teaching of the Food Toxicology course in TCM universities. Methods Fifty Food Hygiene and Nutrition major undergraduates in the class of 2016 were selected as research objects, using the cluster sampling method in a TCM university. The questionnaires were compiled and filled out by students before their first class. Results In this study, 93.88% of the students thought it necessary to set up Food Toxicology course, and 97.96% of them were willing to take the course. The main reason given was that curriculum knowledge was very important and will be helpful in their future work. The main form of study preferred by the majority of respondents (79.59%) was compulsory courses, and 61.22% aimed to master their knowledge of Food Toxicology course. In addition, 97.96% thought that the Food Toxicology course would be useful in their future work. Students had a relatively high cognition of dose-response relationship, food safety assessment and food risk analysis, while their cognition of food toxicology concept was the lowest. Some differences were noted regarding the effect of different cognitive levels of core knowledge on classification, and the course could be divided into three parts for teaching purposes. Conclusion Through the investigation detailed in this study, we now have a preliminary understanding of the cognition of the Food Toxicology course in the Food Hygiene and Nutrition major in the TCM University. During the teaching process, we need to include a Chinese medicine background, and typical cases should be selected, based on the idea of "Homology of Medicine and Food" in traditional medicine.

articleTitle: Interest Preference Information Mining for Online Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the advent of the Internet era, network technology has gradually been applied to education and teaching. The teaching method of online learning, as a derivative of the new teaching model, promotes the development and transformation of traditional education and teaching. Because each student has different learning focus areas and behaviors, it is the research direction of online learning to analyze the learning characteristics of specific students. This paper firstly divides the user type by clustering algorithm, uses the eye movement experiment to obtain the user behavior data, analyzes the data and finds the students' interest areas, which helps the online learning system to formulate specific learning strategies according to different users.

articleTitle: Deep Learning from Small Dataset for BI-RADS Density Classification of Mammography Images
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Mammography is a breast imaging technique that has been widely used in breast cancer diagnosis and screening. The Breast Imaging Reporting and Data System (BI-RADS) defines a six-point overall cancer risk scale from negative to highly suggestive of malignancy based on mammography, and also a four-point breast density based cancer risk scale. Automatic BI-RADS density classification of mammogram images is still a challenge. The current state of the art is about 80% on the MIAS (Mammogram Image Analysis Society) database. In this paper we present a deep learning study of BI-RADS density classification using MIAS, based on a lightweight Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) architecture. This is a small data problem as MIAS has only 322 images with ground truth, so we use image pre-processing and augmentation to solve the problem. Five-fold cross validation is used to evaluate the proposed approach, and has achieved a test accuracy of 83.6% on average. This suggests that deep learning has the potential to address the small data problem in mammography, which is prevalent in many medical image analysis tasks. The experience we have, especially in how to optimize the deep learning architecture, will benefit other researchers and medical practitioners.

Author Keywords: Deep learning, Convolutional neural networks, Breast cancer, Mammography, Breast density classification

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Smart Learning System for Agriculture Education Based on Scientific Inquiry
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Rapid development of smart mobile device shows great potential to support learning, which is a frontier issue in the field of education technology. Aiming at specific problems of curriculum, and then developing particular system to support mobile learning has drawn great attentions. As an effective way for learning science, scientific inquiry has traditionally been the concern of researchers. A considerable amount of literature has been published on how to combine mobile learning with scientific inquiry. However, there are few researches on integrating mobile learning and scientific inquiry into agricultural curriculum teaching. In this paper, we intend to examine how to adapt scientific inquiry and smarting learning environment as the teaching scheme for the design of Practice Teaching in Agriculture Education Smart Learning System (PTAESL). Firstly, the paper analyzes scientific inquiry and smarting learning environment theory through literature review. Upon the foundation above, a smart learning system is designed and realized with using technologies like Java, MySQL database, etc. Then, technology details of the Location Based Service (LBS) learning resource recommendation, learning context awareness and structured inquiry cycle is introduced. In preliminary application on practice teaching of Plant Protection, teachers and students gave positive evaluation on the system. Finally, the implications and limitations of the study are also discussed.

articleTitle: Research on Black Swan in Emerging Markets: Evidence from the Belt and Road Countries
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Black swan is prevalent in emerging markets, leading to affect long-term returns. These outliers have stronger power to determine the performance. This paper from the perspective of big data by using these 9 emerging markets from the belt and road countries and about 60000 daily returns presents that the small outliers have a significant massive effect on long-term performance. Compared with some Asia countries, the Central and Eastern Europe countries' analysis results have some irreplaceable advantages, such as low risk, stable returns, and diversified advantages. From the data analysis, we draw the conclusion that black swans are caused by a cause which means it can be predicted in the forward investment market. For the long-term investment of emerging markets, in good and bad times, maintaining a certain degree of passivity and diversification of investment plays a crucial role.

articleTitle: Optimization of ACE-Inhibitory Hydrolysate Production from Alfalfa (Medicago Sativa L.) Leaf Protein Using Response Surface Modeling
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Alfalfa Leaf protein isolates (ALPI) was extracted by direct heating method of alkali solubilization and acid precipitation, and hydrolyzed by six proteases, including alcalase, neutrase, papain, pepsin, trypsin and flavourzyme, were used to obtain hydrolysates. The results indicated that the alfalfa leaf protein hydrolysate (ALPH) prepared by papain exhibited the highest angiotensin I converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitory activity of 79.69%±2.77% at the same concentration. Therefore, papain was employed to hydrolyze ALPI to produce the ACE inhibitory activity peptides. Then, response surface methodology (RSM) was applied to optimize the hydrolysis conditions (including hydrolysis temperature, enzyme to substrate ratio (E/S) and pH value). The minimum ACE inhibitory rate (92.33%±0.30%) was obtained at an E/S of 3%, a pH of 7.5 and an incubation temperature of 55 <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</sup>C, which agreed with the predicted value estimated by RSM within a 95% confidence interval. It was suggested that alfalfa Leaf protein hydrolysate prepared by papain with good ACE inhibitory activity and could be a potential source of natural ACE inhibitor.

articleTitle: Research on Experimental Teaching Reform of Network Program Curriculum System
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: According to problems in experimental teaching sections of network program curriculum system, we put forward a method on experimental teaching reform focusing on situational cases and theme driven projects. It applies the demand of the staff's abilities in software enterprises to design the experimental program teaching, taking the Wiki technology as the foundation to establish information source and situational cases base. The design and implementation of the approach have demonstrated not only substantial and consistent improvements in students' practical ability in programming, but also the cultivation of many high-level application developers and designers. Ant therefore, it narrows the gap between university software personnel training and the qualified personnel demand of software enterprises. The abilities of students can meet the demands of enterprises before they graduate.

articleTitle: A Fault Analysis and Prediction of Aircraft Based on Association Rules and Weibull Distribution
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In this paper, a fault analysis and prediction of aircraft equipment is proposed via the construction of association rules and the analysis of Weibull Distribution. Firstly, for the recorded data in the airborne detection system, the prefix path graph is introduced to improve the Apriori algorithm to further mine the association rules between the fault equipments with low and high supports. Then, the first failure time of the equipment with high support is recorded, and the reliability analysis model of the equipment is established according to the Weibull distribution. Finally, the results of reliability analysis model obtained from the association rules provide the theoretical basis for the maintenance program of aircraft. The experiments in aircraft airborne detection system verifies the effectiveness and practicability of the proposed method.

Author Keywords: Apriori algorithm based on Prefix Path Graph(A-PPG)

articleTitle: Simulation and Verification for Ion Channel Noises in Neuronal Cells
publicationTitle: 2019 10th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Ion channel noises form the basis of the electrical activity of neurons and have significant clinic implications because these noises reflect how reliable a neuron responses to a given stimulus. Therefore, abundant theoretical work has been done to mathematically model these noises. Traditionally, these noises are numerically simulated in computers but recently a new method called probabilistic model checking has played an increasingly important role in computational biology. In this paper, we model ion channel noises as Continuous-time Markov Chains (CTMCs) and use them as a case study to compare the advantages and disadvantages of simulation and probabilistic model checking. We introduce the algorithms for simulation and demonstrate how to model check the CTMC model of ion channel noises. The results illustrate that simulation is more flexible to implement and closer to real-life observations while model checking can explore all the status of the system and therefore is more suitable to analyze the expected performance and verify important properties. By combining both methods, a deeper insight into ion channel noises can be obtained.
